  // ===========================================================================
  // SSC / HSSC
  // ===========================================================================

  static void _addLevelSummary(
    pw.Document pdf,
    FeeAuditReportBundle report,
    String level,
  ) {
    final ssc = level == 'SSC';

    final codes = ssc
        ? ['9B', '9G', '10B', '10G']
        : ['XIB', 'XIG', 'XIIB', 'XIIG'];

    final subjects = ssc ? report.sscSubjects : report.hsscSubjects;

    final summary = report.summaryFor(level);

    final subjectRows = <List<String>>[];

    subjectRows.add([
      'Total Collection',
      ...codes.map(
        (code) => money(report.totalForClass(code)?.collection ?? 0),
      ),
      money(summary?.collection ?? 0),
      '',
      '',
    ]);

    for (final subject in subjects) {
      subjectRows.add([
        feeSubjectLabel(subject.subjectCode),
        ...codes.map((code) => money(subject.classAmounts[code] ?? 0)),
        money(subject.totalAmount),
        subject.teacherName,
        '________________',
      ]);
    }

    subjectRows.add([
      'Total Teacher Share',
      ...codes.map(
        (code) => money(report.totalForClass(code)?.teacherShare ?? 0),
      ),
      money(summary?.teacher ?? 0),
      '',
      '',
    ]);

    final fundRows = codes.map((code) {
      final row = report.totalForClass(code);

      return [
        code,
        money(row?.collection ?? 0),
        money(row?.teacherShare ?? 0),
        money(row?.nts ?? 0),
        money(row?.building ?? 0),
        money(row?.admin ?? 0),
        money(row?.organizer ?? 0),
        money(row?.ecc ?? 0),
        money(row?.totalDistributed ?? 0),
      ];
    }).toList();

    if (summary != null) {
      fundRows.add([
        'TOTAL',
        money(summary.collection),
        money(summary.teacher),
        money(summary.nts),
        money(summary.building),
        money(summary.admin),
        money(summary.organizer),
        money(summary.ecc),
        money(summary.total),
      ]);
    }

    pdf.addPage(
      pw.Page(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4.landscape,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(12),
        build: (_) {
          return pw.Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              _header(
                'FGEIs Evening Coaching Classes - $level Subject Wise Summary',
                report.paymentMonth,
              ),

              _sectionTitle('Teacher Subject Payments'),

              pw.SizedBox(height: 5),

              pw.TableHelper.fromTextArray(
                headers: [
                  'Subject',
                  ...codes,
                  'Total',
                  'Teacher Name',
                  'Signature',
                ],
                data: subjectRows,
                headerStyle: pw.TextStyle(
                  color: PdfColors.white,
                  fontSize: 7.5,
                  fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                ),
                headerDecoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: PdfColors.blueGrey900,
                ),
                cellStyle: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 7.1),
                cellPadding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(3.8),
                border: pw.TableBorder.all(
                  color: PdfColors.grey500,
                  width: 0.35,
                ),
              ),

              pw.SizedBox(height: 11),

              _sectionTitle('$level Fund Breakdown'),

              pw.SizedBox(height: 5),

              pw.TableHelper.fromTextArray(
                headers: const [
                  'Class',
                  'Collection',
                  'Teacher',
                  'NTS',
                  'Building',
                  'Admin',
                  'Organizer',
                  'ECC',
                  '100%',
                ],
                data: fundRows,
                headerStyle: pw.TextStyle(
                  color: PdfColors.white,
                  fontSize: 6.9,
                  fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                ),
                headerDecoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(
                  color: PdfColors.blueGrey800,
                ),
                cellStyle: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 6.8),
                cellPadding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(3.5),
                border: pw.TableBorder.all(
                  color: PdfColors.grey500,
                  width: 0.35,
                ),
              ),

              pw.Spacer(),

              _twoSignatures(),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

class FeeMonth {
  FeeMonth._();

  static const List<String> abbreviations = [
    'Jan',
    'Feb',
    'Mar',
    'Apr',
    'May',
    'Jun',
    'Jul',
    'Aug',
    'Sept',
    'Oct',
    'Nov',
    'Dec',
  ];

  static const List<String> fullNames = [
    'January',
    'February',
    'March',
    'April',
    'May',
    'June',
    'July',
    'August',
    'September',
    'October',
    'November',
    'December',
  ];

  static String fromDate(DateTime date) {
    return fromParts(date.year, date.month);
  }

  static String fromParts(int year, int month) {
    if (month < 1 || month > 12) {
      throw ArgumentError('Month must be between 1 and 12.');
    }

    return '${abbreviations[month - 1]}-$year';
  }

  static DateTime? parse(String value) {
    final parts = value.split('-');

    if (parts.length != 2) return null;

    final month = abbreviations.indexOf(parts[0]) + 1;
    final year = int.tryParse(parts[1]);

    if (month <= 0 || year == null) return null;

    return DateTime(year, month);
  }

  static List<String> newestFirst(Iterable<String> months) {
    final values = months.toSet().toList();

    values.sort((first, second) {
      final firstDate = parse(first);
      final secondDate = parse(second);

      if (firstDate == null && secondDate == null) {
        return second.compareTo(first);
      }

      if (firstDate == null) return 1;
      if (secondDate == null) return -1;

      return secondDate.compareTo(firstDate);
    });

    return values;
  }
}

import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart';
import 'package:pdf/widgets.dart' as pw;

import '../models/fee_models.dart';

class FeePdfGenerator {
  FeePdfGenerator._();

  static final NumberFormat _moneyFormat = NumberFormat('#,##0.00');

  static String _money(double value) {
    return 'Rs ${_moneyFormat.format(value)}';
  }

  static Future<Uint8List> buildReport({
    required String paymentMonth,
    required List<FeeSummaryRow> rows,
  }) async {
    final pdf = pw.Document(
      title: 'FG Academy Portal - Fee Report $paymentMonth',
      author: 'FG Academy Portal',
      creator: 'FG Academy Portal',
    );

    final collectionRows =
        rows.where((row) => row.section == 'collection').toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder.compareTo(b.sortOrder));

    final sscTeacherRows =
        rows
            .where((row) => row.section == 'teacher' && row.groupName == 'SSC')
            .toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder.compareTo(b.sortOrder));

    final hsscTeacherRows =
        rows
            .where((row) => row.section == 'teacher' && row.groupName == 'HSSC')
            .toList()
          ..sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder.compareTo(b.sortOrder));

    final fundRows = rows.where((row) => row.section == 'fund').toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder.compareTo(b.sortOrder));

    pdf.addPage(
      pw.MultiPage(
        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,
        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(32),
        header: (context) {
          return pw.Container(
            margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 18),
            padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(14),
            decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
              color: PdfColors.blue900,
              borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
            child: pw.Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                pw.Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: pw.CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    pw.Text(
                      'FG Academy Portal',
                      style: pw.TextStyle(
                        color: PdfColors.white,
                        fontSize: 18,
                        fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    pw.SizedBox(height: 3),
                    pw.Text(
                      'Fee Management & Financial Report',
                      style: const pw.TextStyle(
                        color: PdfColors.white,
                        fontSize: 10,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                pw.Text(
                  paymentMonth,
                  style: pw.TextStyle(
                    color: PdfColors.amber200,
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
        footer: (context) {
          return pw.Container(
            margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
            child: pw.Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: pw.MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                pw.Text(
                  'Generated by FG Academy Portal',
                  style: const pw.TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 8,
                    color: PdfColors.grey700,
                  ),
                ),
                pw.Text(
                  'Page ${context.pageNumber} of ${context.pagesCount}',
                  style: const pw.TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 8,
                    color: PdfColors.grey700,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
        build: (context) {
          return [
            _sectionTitle('1. Total Collection Summary'),
            _collectionTable(collectionRows),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 22),

            _sectionTitle('2. Teacher Payouts - SSC'),
            _teacherTable(sscTeacherRows),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 22),

            _sectionTitle('Teacher Payouts - HSSC'),
            _teacherTable(hsscTeacherRows),
            pw.SizedBox(height: 22),

            _sectionTitle('3. Fund Payouts'),
            _fundTable(fundRows),
          ];
        },
      ),
    );

    return pdf.save();
  }

  static pw.Widget _sectionTitle(String title) {
    return pw.Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 7),
      decoration: pw.BoxDecoration(
        color: PdfColors.grey200,
        borderRadius: pw.BorderRadius.circular(5),
      ),
      child: pw.Text(
        title,
        style: pw.TextStyle(
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,
          color: PdfColors.blue900,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _collectionTable(List<FeeSummaryRow> rows) {
    final data = rows.map((row) {
      return [
        row.itemName,
        _money(row.amount),
        row.paidStudents.toString(),
        row.unpaidStudents.toString(),
      ];
    }).toList();

    return _table(
      headers: const ['Collection', 'Amount', 'Paid', 'Unpaid'],
      data: data,
      rightAlignedColumns: const {1, 2, 3},
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _teacherTable(List<FeeSummaryRow> rows) {
    final data = rows.map((row) {
      final label = row.itemName == 'Total Teacher Share'
          ? row.itemName
          : feeSubjectLabel(row.itemName);

      return [label, _money(row.amount), row.paidStudents.toString()];
    }).toList();

    return _table(
      headers: const ['Teacher / Subject', 'Payout', 'Students'],
      data: data,
      rightAlignedColumns: const {1, 2},
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _fundTable(List<FeeSummaryRow> rows) {
    final data = rows.map((row) {
      return [row.itemName, _money(row.amount)];
    }).toList();

    return _table(
      headers: const ['Fund', 'Payout'],
      data: data,
      rightAlignedColumns: const {1},
    );
  }

  static pw.Widget _table({
    required List<String> headers,
    required List<List<String>> data,
    Set<int> rightAlignedColumns = const {},
  }) {
    pw.Widget buildCell(String value, int index, {bool header = false}) {
      return pw.Padding(
        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 6),
        child: pw.Text(
          value,
          textAlign: rightAlignedColumns.contains(index)
              ? pw.TextAlign.right
              : pw.TextAlign.left,
          style: pw.TextStyle(
            fontSize: header ? 9 : 8.5,
            color: header ? PdfColors.white : PdfColors.grey900,
            fontWeight: header ? pw.FontWeight.bold : pw.FontWeight.normal,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return pw.Table(
      border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300, width: 0.5),
      children: [
        pw.TableRow(
          decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.blueGrey800),
          children: [
            for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++)
              buildCell(headers[i], i, header: true),
          ],
        ),
        ...data.map(
          (row) => pw.TableRow(
            children: [
              for (int i = 0; i < row.length; i++) buildCell(row[i], i),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

int compareBatchNames(dynamic first, dynamic second) {
  final firstName = (first['name'] as String? ?? '').trim();
  final secondName = (second['name'] as String? ?? '').trim();
  final firstMatch = RegExp(
    r'(\d+).*?(boys?|girls?)',
    caseSensitive: false,
  ).firstMatch(firstName);
  final secondMatch = RegExp(
    r'(\d+).*?(boys?|girls?)',
    caseSensitive: false,
  ).firstMatch(secondName);

  if (firstMatch == null && secondMatch == null) {
    return firstName.toLowerCase().compareTo(secondName.toLowerCase());
  }
  if (firstMatch == null) return 1;
  if (secondMatch == null) return -1;

  final gradeComparison = int.parse(
    firstMatch.group(1)!,
  ).compareTo(int.parse(secondMatch.group(1)!));
  if (gradeComparison != 0) return gradeComparison;

  final firstGender = firstMatch.group(2)!.toLowerCase();
  final secondGender = secondMatch.group(2)!.toLowerCase();
  final genderComparison = _genderRank(
    firstGender,
  ).compareTo(_genderRank(secondGender));
  if (genderComparison != 0) return genderComparison;

  return firstName.toLowerCase().compareTo(secondName.toLowerCase());
}

int _genderRank(String gender) => gender.startsWith('boy') ? 0 : 1;

List<dynamic> sortBatches(List<dynamic> batches) {
  final sortedBatches = List<dynamic>.from(batches);
  sortedBatches.sort(compareBatchNames);
  return sortedBatches;
}

int compareStudentNames(dynamic first, dynamic second) {
  final firstName = (first['name'] as String? ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  final secondName = (second['name'] as String? ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return firstName.compareTo(secondName);
}

List<dynamic> sortStudents(List<dynamic> students) {
  final sortedStudents = List<dynamic>.from(students);
  sortedStudents.sort(compareStudentNames);
  return sortedStudents;
}

class StudentSubjectPreset {
  final String code;
  final String label;
  final List<String> subjects;

  const StudentSubjectPreset({
    required this.code,
    required this.label,
    required this.subjects,
  });
}

const List<String> _studentSubjectOrder = [
  'Phy',
  'Chem',
  'Math',
  'Eng',
  'Comp',
  'Bio',
];

String studentSubjectLabel(String code) {
  switch (code) {
    case 'Phy':
      return 'Physics';

    case 'Chem':
      return 'Chemistry';

    case 'Math':
      return 'Mathematics';

    case 'Eng':
      return 'English';

    case 'Comp':
      return 'Computer';

    case 'Bio':
      return 'Biology';

    default:
      return code;
  }
}

List<String> studentSubjectCodesForClass(int classLevel) {
  if (classLevel >= 9 && classLevel <= 12) {
    return List<String>.from(_studentSubjectOrder);
  }

  return const [];
}

int studentMaxSubjectsForClass(int classLevel) {
  if (classLevel == 9 || classLevel == 10) {
    return 5;
  }

  if (classLevel == 11 || classLevel == 12) {
    return 4;
  }

  return 0;
}

List<String> studentDefaultSubjectsForClass(int classLevel) {
  // SSC:
  // Start with the four normal/core subjects.
  // Teacher/admin can uncheck any of them for
  // partial-subject students.
  if (classLevel == 9 || classLevel == 10) {
    return const ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng'];
  }

  // HSSC:
  // Physics + English checked by default,
  // exactly as requested.
  if (classLevel == 11 || classLevel == 12) {
    return const ['Phy', 'Eng'];
  }

  return const [];
}

List<StudentSubjectPreset> studentSubjectPresetsForClass(int classLevel) {
  if (classLevel == 9 || classLevel == 10) {
    return const [
      StudentSubjectPreset(
        code: 'Comp',
        label: 'Computer',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Comp'],
      ),
      StudentSubjectPreset(
        code: 'Bio',
        label: 'Biology',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Bio'],
      ),
    ];
  }

  if (classLevel == 11 || classLevel == 12) {
    return const [
      StudentSubjectPreset(
        code: 'Comp',
        label: 'FCS',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Comp'],
      ),
      StudentSubjectPreset(
        code: 'Chem',
        label: 'Pre-Engineering',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng'],
      ),
      StudentSubjectPreset(
        code: 'Bio',
        label: 'Pre-Medical',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Eng', 'Bio'],
      ),
    ];
  }

  return const [];
}

List<String> normalizeStudentSubjects(
  int classLevel,
  Iterable<String> subjects,
) {
  final allowed = studentSubjectCodesForClass(classLevel).toSet();

  final values = subjects.where(allowed.contains).toSet();

  return _studentSubjectOrder.where(values.contains).toList();
}

String? studentSubjectSelectionError(
  int classLevel,
  Iterable<String> subjects,
) {
  final values = normalizeStudentSubjects(classLevel, subjects);

  if (values.isEmpty) {
    return 'Select at least one subject.';
  }

  final max = studentMaxSubjectsForClass(classLevel);

  if (max <= 0) {
    return 'Unsupported class level.';
  }

  if (values.length > max) {
    return 'Class $classLevel students can study maximum $max subjects.';
  }

  // Classes 9/10: Computer and Biology are alternatives.
  if (classLevel == 9 || classLevel == 10) {
    if (values.contains('Comp') && values.contains('Bio')) {
      return 'Classes 9/10 cannot have both Computer and Biology.';
    }
  }

  // Classes 11/12: enforce valid HSSC combinations.
  if (classLevel == 11 || classLevel == 12) {
    if (values.contains('Bio') && values.contains('Math')) {
      return 'Biology and Mathematics cannot be selected together.';
    }

    if (values.contains('Bio') && values.contains('Comp')) {
      return 'Biology and Computer cannot be selected together.';
    }

    if (values.contains('Comp') && values.contains('Chem')) {
      return 'Computer and Chemistry cannot be selected together.';
    }
  }

  return null;
}

bool _sameSubjectSet(Iterable<String> first, Iterable<String> second) {
  final a = first.toSet();
  final b = second.toSet();

  return a.length == b.length && a.containsAll(b);
}

// ============================================================================
// BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE HELPERS
//
// Existing code can continue to compile while presets remain convenient.
// ============================================================================

List<String> studentGroupCodesForClass(int classLevel) {
  return studentSubjectPresetsForClass(
    classLevel,
  ).map((preset) => preset.code).toList();
}

String studentGroupLabel(int classLevel, String groupCode) {
  for (final preset in studentSubjectPresetsForClass(classLevel)) {
    if (preset.code == groupCode) {
      return preset.label;
    }
  }

  return groupCode;
}

List<String> studentSubjectsForGroup(int classLevel, String groupCode) {
  for (final preset in studentSubjectPresetsForClass(classLevel)) {
    if (preset.code == groupCode) {
      return List<String>.from(preset.subjects);
    }
  }

  return const [];
}

String? inferStudentGroupCode(int classLevel, Iterable<String> subjects) {
  final normalized = normalizeStudentSubjects(classLevel, subjects);

  for (final preset in studentSubjectPresetsForClass(classLevel)) {
    if (_sameSubjectSet(normalized, preset.subjects)) {
      return preset.code;
    }
  }

  // Partial/custom student = no fake stream label.
  return null;
}

class SimpleAddStudentResult {

    required this.groupCode,
  });

class _StreamOption {
  final String code;
  final String label;
  final List<String> subjects;

  const _StreamOption({
    required this.code,
    required this.label,
    required this.subjects,
  });
}

List<_StreamOption> _getStreamsForClass(int classLevel) {
  if (classLevel == 9 || classLevel == 10) {
    return const [
      _StreamOption(
        code: 'Comp',
        label: 'Computer',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Comp'],
      ),
      _StreamOption(
        code: 'Bio',
        label: 'Biology',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Bio'],
      ),
    ];
  }

  if (classLevel == 11 || classLevel == 12) {
    return const [
      _StreamOption(
        code: 'Comp',
        label: 'FCS',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Comp'],
      ),
      _StreamOption(
        code: 'Chem',
        label: 'Pre-Engineering',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng'],
      ),
      _StreamOption(
        code: 'Bio',
        label: 'Pre-Medical',
        subjects: ['Phy', 'Chem', 'Eng', 'Bio'],
      ),
    ];
  }

  return const [];
}

Future<SimpleAddStudentResult?> showAcademyAddStudentDialog({
  required BuildContext context,
  List<FeeBatch>? batches,
  FeeBatch? initialBatch,
  bool lockBatch = false,
  String? requiredSubject,
}) async {
  final allBatches = batches ?? (initialBatch != null ? [initialBatch] : <FeeBatch>[]);

  if (allBatches.isEmpty) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(
        content: Text('No batches available to add a student.'),
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
      ),
    );
    return null;
  }

  FeeBatch selectedBatch = initialBatch ?? allBatches.first;
  final showBatchSelector = !lockBatch && allBatches.length > 1 && initialBatch == null;

  final nameController = TextEditingController();
  final scrollController = ScrollController();
  final streamKey = GlobalKey();
  final streamFocusNode = FocusNode();

  String? selectedStreamCode;
  String? nameError;
  String? streamError;
  String? dialogError;
  bool isSubmitting = false;

  try {
    return await showDialog<SimpleAddStudentResult>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setDialogState) {
            final streams = _getStreamsForClass(selectedBatch.classLevel);

            return AlertDialog(
              insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 16,
                vertical: 24,
              ),
              title: Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.person_add_alt_1_rounded,
                    color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'Add New Student',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 18,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              content: SizedBox(
                width: 460,
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  controller: scrollController,
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      // Batch selector only if no batch is already selected
                      if (showBatchSelector) ...[
                        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                          key: ValueKey(selectedBatch.id),
                          initialValue: selectedBatch.id,
                          isExpanded: true,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(
                            labelText: 'Batch *',
                            prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.class_outlined),
                          ),
                          items: allBatches.map((batch) {
                            return DropdownMenuItem(
                              value: batch.id,
                              child: Text(
                                batch.name,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              ),
                            );
                          }).toList(),
                          onChanged: isSubmitting
                              ? null
                              : (value) {
                                  if (value == null) return;
                                  final newBatch = allBatches.firstWhere(
                                    (b) => b.id == value,
                                  );
                                  setDialogState(() {
                                    selectedBatch = newBatch;
                                    selectedStreamCode = null;
                                    streamError = null;
                                    dialogError = null;
                                  });
                                },
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      ] else ...[
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 12,
                            vertical: 9,
                          ),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              const Icon(
                                Icons.school_outlined,
                                size: 18,
                                color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  '${selectedBatch.name}  (Class ${selectedBatch.classLevel})',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      ],

                      // Student Name
                      TextFormField(
                        controller: nameController,
                        autofocus: true,
                        enabled: !isSubmitting,
                        textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          labelText: 'Student Name *',
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.person_outline),
                          errorText: nameError,
                        ),
                        onChanged: (_) {
                          if (nameError != null) {
                            setDialogState(() {
                              nameError = null;
                              dialogError = null;
                            });
                          }
                        },
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 20),

                      // Stream selector with focus node and key for auto-scroll
                      Focus(
                        focusNode: streamFocusNode,
                        child: Container(
                          key: streamKey,
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                            children: [
                              Row(
                                children: const [
                                  Text(
                                    'Stream',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 14,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      color: AppTheme.textPrimary,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  Text(
                                    ' *',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                      fontSize: 14,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 8),
                              ...streams.map((opt) {
                                final isSelected = selectedStreamCode == opt.code;
                                return Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                                  child: InkWell(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                    onTap: isSubmitting
                                        ? null

                                            setDialogState(() {
                                              selectedStreamCode = opt.code;
                                              streamError = null;
                                              dialogError = null;

                                            ? AppTheme.fgNavyBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
                                            : Colors.transparent,
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                        border: Border.all(
                                          color: isSelected
                                              ? AppTheme.fgNavyBlue
                                              : (streamError != null
                                                  ? AppTheme.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                                                  : Colors.grey.shade300),
                                          width: isSelected ? 2 : 1,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                      child: Row(
                                        children: [
                                          Icon(
                                            isSelected
                                                ? Icons.radio_button_checked
                                                : Icons.radio_button_off,
                                            color: isSelected
                                                ? AppTheme.fgNavyBlue
                                                : AppTheme.textSecondary,
                                            size: 20,
                                          ),
                                          const SizedBox(width: 12),
                                          Expanded(
                                            child: Column(
                                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                              children: [
                                                Text(
                                                  opt.label,
                                                  style: TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 14.5,
                                                    fontWeight: isSelected
                                                        ? FontWeight.w800
                                                        : FontWeight.w600,
                                                    color: isSelected
                                                        ? AppTheme.fgNavyBlue
                                                        : AppTheme.textPrimary,
                                                  ),
                                                ),
                                                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                                Text(
                                                  opt.subjects
                                                      .map(studentSubjectLabel)
                                                      .join(' • '),
                                                  style: TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 12,
                                                    color: isSelected
                                                        ? AppTheme.fgNavyBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.8)
                                                        : AppTheme.textSecondary,
                                                  ),
                                                ),
                                              ],
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        ],
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                );
                              }),
                              if (streamError != null) ...[
                                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                Row(
                                  children: [
                                    const Icon(
                                      Icons.error_outline_rounded,
                                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      size: 15,
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(
                                        streamError!,
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: AppTheme.danger,
                                          fontSize: 12.5,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ],
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      if (dialogError != null) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 14),
                        Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: AppTheme.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: AppTheme.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              const Icon(
                                Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
                                color: AppTheme.danger,
                                size: 18,
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                  dialogError!,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: AppTheme.danger,
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              actions: [
                TextButton(
                  onPressed: isSubmitting
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
                        },
                  child: const Text('Cancel'),
                ),
                ElevatedButton.icon(
                  icon: isSubmitting
                      ? const SizedBox(
                          width: 16,
                          height: 16,
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            color: Colors.white,
                          ),
                        )
                      : const Icon(Icons.person_add),
                  label: const Text('Add Student'),
                  onPressed: isSubmitting
                      ? null
                      : () async {
                          final name = nameController.text.trim();

                          bool hasError = false;

                          if (name.isEmpty) {
                            setDialogState(() {
                              nameError = 'Student name is required.';
                            });
                            hasError = true;
                          }

                          if (selectedStreamCode == null) {
                            setDialogState(() {
                              streamError = 'Please select a stream';
                            });
                            hasError = true;

                            // Auto-scroll and focus to stream field
                            streamFocusNode.requestFocus();
                            if (scrollController.hasClients) {
                              scrollController.animateTo(
                                scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent,
                                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                                curve: Curves.easeOut,
                              );
                            }
                          } else if (requiredSubject != null) {
                            final chosenStream = streams.firstWhere(
                              (s) => s.code == selectedStreamCode,
                              orElse: () => streams.first,
                            );
                            if (!chosenStream.subjects.contains(requiredSubject)) {
                              setDialogState(() {
                                streamError =
                                    'Selected stream must include your teaching subject (${studentSubjectLabel(requiredSubject)}).';
                              });
                              hasError = true;
                              streamFocusNode.requestFocus();
                            }
                          }

                          if (hasError) return;

                          setDialogState(() {
                            isSubmitting = true;
                            dialogError = null;
                          });

                          try {
                            final result = await Supabase.instance.client.rpc(
                              'portal_add_student_simple',
                              params: {
                                'p_name': name,
                                'p_batch_id': selectedBatch.id,
                                'p_group_code': selectedStreamCode,
                              },
                            );

                            final studentId = result?.toString() ?? '';

                            if (!dialogContext.mounted) return;

                            Navigator.pop(
                              dialogContext,
                              SimpleAddStudentResult(
                                studentId: studentId,
                                name: name,
                                batchId: selectedBatch.id,
                                groupCode: selectedStreamCode!,
                              ),
                            );
                          } catch (e) {
                            debugPrint('portal_add_student_simple error: $e');

                            var friendlyMessage =
                                'Could not add student. Please try again.';
                            final raw = e.toString().toLowerCase();

                            if (raw.contains('already exists')) {
                              if (raw.contains('archived')) {
                                friendlyMessage =
                                    'An archived student with this name already exists in this batch. Restore the student instead.';
                              } else {
                                friendlyMessage =
                                    'A student with this name already exists in this batch.';
                              }
                            } else if (raw.contains('not allowed') ||
                                raw.contains('permission')) {
                              friendlyMessage =
                                  'You do not have permission to add a student to this batch.';
                            } else if (raw.contains('teaching subject')) {
                              friendlyMessage =
                                  'The student must include your teaching subject.';
                            } else if (raw.contains('stream')) {
                              friendlyMessage = 'Invalid stream selection.';
                            }

                            setDialogState(() {
                              isSubmitting = false;
                              dialogError = friendlyMessage;
                            });
                          }
                        },
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  } finally {
    nameController.dispose();
    scrollController.dispose();
    streamFocusNode.dispose();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../app_theme.dart';
import '../utils/student_group_helper.dart';

class StudentSubjectSelector extends StatelessWidget {
  final int classLevel;

  final List<String> selectedSubjects;

  final ValueChanged<List<String>> onChanged;

  final ValueChanged<String>? onValidationError;

  const StudentSubjectSelector({
    super.key,
    required this.classLevel,
    required this.selectedSubjects,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.onValidationError,
  });

  bool _sameSet(Iterable<String> a, Iterable<String> b) {
    final first = a.toSet();
    final second = b.toSet();

    return first.length == second.length && first.containsAll(second);
  }

  void _toggleSubject(String code, bool selected) {
    final next = selectedSubjects.toSet();

    if (selected) {
      // SSC: Computer and Biology remain alternatives.
      // Selecting one automatically removes the other.
      if (classLevel == 9 || classLevel == 10) {
        if (code == 'Comp') {
          next.remove('Bio');
        }

        if (code == 'Bio') {
          next.remove('Comp');
        }
      }

      next.add(code);

      // Prevent invalid HSSC combinations
      // and exceeding the maximum subjects.
      final validation = studentSubjectSelectionError(classLevel, next);

      if (validation != null) {
        onValidationError?.call(validation);
        return;
      }
    } else {
      // Allow unchecking subjects, including
      // when a student studies only selected subjects.
      next.remove(code);
    }

    onChanged(normalizeStudentSubjects(classLevel, next));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final allowed = studentSubjectCodesForClass(classLevel);

    final presets = studentSubjectPresetsForClass(classLevel);

    final max = studentMaxSubjectsForClass(classLevel);

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            const Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'Subjects',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue,
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue.withValues(alpha: 0.07),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              ),
              child: Text(
                '${selectedSubjects.length} / $max',
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue,
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 5),

        const Text(
          'Presets are optional. Select a preset for speed, then change any checkbox if this student studies fewer or different subjects.',
          style: TextStyle(
            color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
            fontSize: 12.5,
            height: 1.4,
          ),
        ),

        if (presets.isNotEmpty) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 13),

          const Text(
            'Quick Presets',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 7),

          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 8,
            children: presets.map((preset) {
              final selected = _sameSet(selectedSubjects, preset.subjects);

              return ChoiceChip(
                selected: selected,
                avatar: Icon(
                  selected
                      ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                      : Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                  size: 17,
                ),
                label: Text(
                  preset.label,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                ),
                onSelected: (_) {
                  onChanged(List<String>.from(preset.subjects));
                },
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
        ],

        const SizedBox(height: 16),

        ...allowed.map((code) {
          final checked = selectedSubjects.contains(code);

          final isHssc = classLevel == 11 || classLevel == 12;

          // An unchecked subject is disabled if selecting
          // it would create an invalid HSSC combination
          // or exceed the 4-subject limit.
          final blocked =
              isHssc &&
              !checked &&
              studentSubjectSelectionError(classLevel, [
                    ...selectedSubjects,
                    code,
                  ]) !=
                  null;

          return CheckboxListTile(
            value: checked,
            dense: true,
            contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
            activeColor: AppTheme.fgNavyBlue,
            title: Text(
              studentSubjectLabel(code),
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
              ),
            ),
            onChanged: blocked
                ? null
                : (value) {
                    _toggleSubject(code, value ?? false);
                  },
          );
        }),

        const SizedBox(height: 4),

        Text(
          classLevel <= 10
              ? 'SSC: maximum 5 subjects. Computer and Biology cannot both be selected.'
              : 'HSSC: maximum 4 subjects. Biology cannot combine with Math or Computer. Computer cannot combine with Chemistry. Invalid options are disabled.',
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            height: 1.4,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

-- ============================================================================
-- MIGRATION: 001_student_archive_safe.sql
-- PURPOSE: Safe, non-destructive Student Archive & Restore System
--
-- GAPS ADDRESSED IN THIS REVISION:
-- 1. Attendance Read-Only Enforcement:
--    Blocks INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE on public.attendance for archived
--    students via both RLS policies and row-level trigger. Admins retain full
--    SELECT access to historical attendance; teachers remain restricted to
--    active students only.
-- 2. Award Marks Immutability & Cascade Protection:
--    A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE trigger on public.award_marks
--    blocks any mutation or removal of marks belonging to an archived student.
--    This protects historical marks against save_award_marks(),
--    clear_award_mark(), delete_award_test(), and foreign key cascading deletes,
--    while preserving all standard active-student workflows.
-- 3. Hard Delete Prevention:
--    Blocks hard DELETE on public.students and public.batches.
-- 4. Admin-Only Archive & Restore RPCs:
--    Provides archive_student() and restore_student() with strict is_portal_admin()
--    checks, preserving original student UUIDs and all historical records.
--
-- SAFETY GUARANTEES:
-- - No tables, views, functions, or columns are dropped.
-- - No fee tables, fee columns, or fee RPCs are altered or removed.
-- - No existing student, attendance, or award mark records are altered.
-- - Transaction-wrapped and idempotent (safe to review and rerun).
-- ============================================================================

BEGIN;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. ADD ARCHIVE METADATA TO STUDENTS TABLE
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ALTER TABLE public.students
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived_at timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived_by uuid,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archive_reason text;

-- Performance indexes for active vs archived student queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_students_active_batch
  ON public.students (batch_id, name)
  WHERE is_archived = false;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_students_archived
  ON public.students (archived_at DESC)
  WHERE is_archived = true;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. HARD DELETE PREVENTION (STUDENTS & BATCHES)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Prevent hard delete of student records (preserves attendance & marks history)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_student_hard_delete()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student hard deletion is disabled. Archive the student instead.'
    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_student_hard_delete ON public.students;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_student_hard_delete
  BEFORE DELETE ON public.students
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_student_hard_delete();

-- Prevent hard delete of batches (avoids cascade deletion of students/attendance)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_batch_hard_delete()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Batch deletion is disabled to protect student, attendance, and award history.'
    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_batch_hard_delete ON public.batches;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_batch_hard_delete
  BEFORE DELETE ON public.batches
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_batch_hard_delete();

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. ADMIN-ONLY ARCHIVE AND RESTORE RPCs
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Archive student RPC: marks student as archived and preserves student UUID & history
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.archive_student(
  p_student_id uuid,
  p_reason text DEFAULT 'Left academy'
) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only an active administrator can archive students.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.students
     SET is_archived = true,
         archived_at = now(),
         archived_by = auth.uid(),
         archive_reason = COALESCE(left(nullif(btrim(p_reason), ''), 500), 'Left academy')
   WHERE id = p_student_id
     AND is_archived = false;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student not found or already archived.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

-- Restore student RPC: clears archive status while preserving exact UUID & history
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_student(
  p_student_id uuid
) RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only an active administrator can restore students.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.students
     SET is_archived = false,
         archived_at = null,
         archived_by = null,
         archive_reason = null
   WHERE id = p_student_id
     AND is_archived = true;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student not found or not currently archived.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.archive_student(uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.restore_student(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.archive_student(uuid, text) TO authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.restore_student(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. RLS & ACCESS CONTROL ON STUDENTS TABLE
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Restrict archived students from teacher-facing SELECT while allowing admin full view
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS students_select_portal ON public.students;
CREATE POLICY students_select_portal ON public.students
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_portal_admin()
    OR (is_archived = false AND public.can_access_batch(batch_id))
  );

-- Remove direct DELETE permission from client queries on students table
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS students_delete_admin ON public.students;
REVOKE DELETE ON public.students FROM anon, authenticated;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. ATTENDANCE PROTECTION (READ-ONLY HISTORICAL ACCESS FOR ARCHIVED STUDENTS)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helper function: ensures non-admins can only manage attendance for active students
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_attendance(
  p_student_id uuid,
  p_batch_id uuid
) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
    WHERE s.id = p_student_id
      AND s.batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND s.is_archived = false
      AND public.can_access_batch(p_batch_id)
  );
$$;

-- Update Attendance RLS policies to prohibit mutation of archived student rows,
-- even for admins, while preserving admin SELECT access to historical records.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS attendance_insert_portal ON public.attendance;
CREATE POLICY attendance_insert_portal ON public.attendance
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_manage_attendance(student_id, batch_id))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
      WHERE s.id = attendance.student_id AND s.is_archived = true
    )
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS attendance_update_portal ON public.attendance;
CREATE POLICY attendance_update_portal ON public.attendance
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_manage_attendance(student_id, batch_id))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
      WHERE s.id = attendance.student_id AND s.is_archived = true
    )
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_manage_attendance(student_id, batch_id))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
      WHERE s.id = attendance.student_id AND s.is_archived = true
    )
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS attendance_delete_admin ON public.attendance;
CREATE POLICY attendance_delete_admin ON public.attendance
  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_portal_admin()
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
      WHERE s.id = attendance.student_id AND s.is_archived = true
    )
  );

-- Row-level trigger on public.attendance:
-- Enforces that no attendance row belonging to an archived student can be
-- inserted, modified, or deleted by any user or SECURITY DEFINER function.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_archived_student_attendance_change()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_student_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    v_student_id := OLD.student_id;
  ELSE
    v_student_id := NEW.student_id;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
    WHERE s.id = v_student_id
      AND s.is_archived = true
  ) THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot delete historical attendance records of an archived student.'
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    ELSE
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot record or modify attendance for an archived student. Restore the student first.'
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  ELSE
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_protect_archived_student_attendance ON public.attendance;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_archived_student_attendance
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.attendance
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_archived_student_attendance_change();

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. AWARD MARKS PROTECTION (IMMUTABILITY & CASCADE PROTECTION)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Row-level trigger on public.award_marks:
-- Blocks INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE of marks belonging to an archived student.
-- This protects archived marks against:
-- - save_award_marks()
-- - clear_award_mark()
-- - delete_award_test() (which runs DELETE FROM award_marks WHERE test_id = ...)
-- - Foreign key cascading deletes (ON DELETE CASCADE from award_tests or students)
-- Normal active-student workflows are unaffected because active students have is_archived = false.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_archived_student_award_mark_change()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_student_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    v_student_id := OLD.student_id;
  ELSE
    v_student_id := NEW.student_id;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
    WHERE s.id = v_student_id
      AND s.is_archived = true
  ) THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot delete or alter historical award marks of an archived student.'
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    ELSE
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot record or modify award marks for an archived student. Restore the student first.'
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  ELSE
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_protect_archived_student_award_marks ON public.award_marks;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_archived_student_award_marks
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.award_marks
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_archived_student_award_mark_change();

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. SIMPLIFIED STUDENT CREATION RPC (STREAM-BASED)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Creates student with mandatory stream code, setting default fees automatically:
-- - Rs 5,500 for Classes 9/10
-- - Rs 6,000 for Classes 11/12
-- Converts stream code into full subjects array:
--   Classes 9 & 10:
--     'Comp' -> Phy, Chem, Math, Eng, Comp
--     'Bio'  -> Phy, Chem, Math, Eng, Bio
--   Classes 11 & 12:
--     'Comp' -> Phy, Math, Eng, Comp (FCS)
--     'Chem' -> Phy, Chem, Math, Eng (Pre-Engineering)
--     'Bio'  -> Phy, Chem, Eng, Bio (Pre-Medical)
-- Preserves existing new-student attendance behavior (marks today as Present).
-- Prevents re-creating an archived student with the same name.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_simple(
  p_name text,
  p_batch_id uuid,
  p_group_code text
) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_class_level integer;
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_trimmed_name text := btrim(COALESCE(p_name, ''));
  v_code text := btrim(COALESCE(p_group_code, ''));
  v_subjects text[];
  v_default_fee numeric;
  v_today date := current_date;
BEGIN
  -- Permission check
  IF NOT (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_access_batch(p_batch_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'You do not have permission to add students to this batch.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF v_trimmed_name = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student name is required.'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  -- Get class level
  SELECT class_level INTO v_class_level
  FROM public.batches
  WHERE id = p_batch_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Batch not found.'
      USING ERRCODE = '23503';
  END IF;

  -- Check active student duplicate
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students
    WHERE batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND lower(btrim(name)) = lower(v_trimmed_name)
      AND is_archived = false
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'A student with this name already exists in this batch.'
      USING ERRCODE = '23505';
  END IF;

  -- Check archived student duplicate
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students
    WHERE batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND lower(btrim(name)) = lower(v_trimmed_name)
      AND is_archived = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'An archived student with this name already exists in this batch. Restore the student instead.'
      USING ERRCODE = '23505';
  END IF;

  -- Stream mapping & fee assignment
  IF v_class_level IN (9, 10) THEN
    v_default_fee := 5500;
    IF v_code = 'Comp' THEN
      v_subjects := ARRAY['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Comp'];
    ELSIF v_code = 'Bio' THEN
      v_subjects := ARRAY['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Bio'];
    ELSE
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid stream for class %: %. Expected Comp or Bio.', v_class_level, v_code
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
  ELSIF v_class_level IN (11, 12) THEN
    v_default_fee := 6000;
    IF v_code = 'Comp' THEN
      v_subjects := ARRAY['Phy', 'Math', 'Eng', 'Comp'];
    ELSIF v_code = 'Chem' THEN
      v_subjects := ARRAY['Phy', 'Chem', 'Math', 'Eng'];
    ELSIF v_code = 'Bio' THEN
      v_subjects := ARRAY['Phy', 'Chem', 'Eng', 'Bio'];
    ELSE
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid stream for class %: %. Expected Comp, Chem, or Bio.', v_class_level, v_code
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported class level %.', v_class_level
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;

  -- Insert student
  INSERT INTO public.students (
    name,
    batch_id,
    stream,
    default_fee,
    status,
    is_archived
  ) VALUES (
    v_trimmed_name,
    p_batch_id,
    v_subjects,
    v_default_fee,
    'enrolled',
    false
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_student_id;

  -- Mark today's attendance as Present
  INSERT INTO public.attendance (
    student_id,
    batch_id,
    date,
    status
  ) VALUES (
    v_student_id,
    p_batch_id,
    v_today,
    'present'
  ) ON CONFLICT (student_id, date) DO NOTHING;

  RETURN v_student_id;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_simple(text, uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_simple(text, uuid, text) TO authenticated;

COMMIT;

FILE END: supabase/migrations/001_student_archive_safe.sql

==========================================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- ROLLBACK SCRIPT: 001_student_archive_safe_rollback.sql
-- PURPOSE: Restores original schema state prior to 001_student_archive_safe.sql
--
-- SAFETY GUARANTEES:
-- - Restores original RLS policies, trigger states, and helper functions.
-- - Restores original DELETE permissions.
-- - Preserves archive metadata columns (is_archived, archived_at, archived_by,
--   archive_reason) by default to prevent casual data loss.
-- - Wrapped in a single transaction block.
-- ============================================================================

BEGIN;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. DROP ADDED ROW-LEVEL PROTECTION TRIGGERS & FUNCTIONS
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Remove award marks protection trigger
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_protect_archived_student_award_marks ON public.award_marks;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.prevent_archived_student_award_mark_change();

-- Remove attendance protection trigger
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_protect_archived_student_attendance ON public.attendance;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.prevent_archived_student_attendance_change();

-- Remove hard delete blockers
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_batch_hard_delete ON public.batches;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.prevent_batch_hard_delete();

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_student_hard_delete ON public.students;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.prevent_student_hard_delete();

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DROP ARCHIVE, RESTORE & ADD RPCs
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.archive_student(uuid, text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.restore_student(uuid);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.portal_add_student_simple(text, uuid, text);

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. RESTORE ORIGINAL STUDENTS RLS POLICIES & DELETE PERMISSIONS
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Restore original students_select_portal policy
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS students_select_portal ON public.students;
CREATE POLICY students_select_portal ON public.students
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_portal_admin()
    OR public.can_access_batch(batch_id)
  );

-- Restore original students_delete_admin policy & grants
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS students_delete_admin ON public.students;
CREATE POLICY students_delete_admin ON public.students
  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_portal_admin()
  );

GRANT DELETE ON public.students TO authenticated;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. RESTORE ORIGINAL ATTENDANCE RLS POLICIES & HELPER FUNCTION
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Restore original can_manage_attendance function definition
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_attendance(
  p_student_id uuid,
  p_batch_id uuid
) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.students s
    WHERE s.id = p_student_id
      AND s.batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND public.can_access_batch(p_batch_id)
  );
$$;

-- Restore original attendance RLS policies
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS attendance_insert_portal ON public.attendance;
CREATE POLICY attendance_insert_portal ON public.attendance
  FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_manage_attendance(student_id, batch_id))
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS attendance_update_portal ON public.attendance;
CREATE POLICY attendance_update_portal ON public.attendance
  FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
  USING (
    (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_manage_attendance(student_id, batch_id))
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_manage_attendance(student_id, batch_id))
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS attendance_delete_admin ON public.attendance;
CREATE POLICY attendance_delete_admin ON public.attendance
  FOR DELETE TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_portal_admin()
  );

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. DROP ADDED INDEXES
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.idx_students_active_batch;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.idx_students_archived;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. ARCHIVE METADATA COLUMNS (PRESERVED BY DEFAULT)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NOTE: The archive columns (is_archived, archived_at, archived_by, archive_reason)
-- are NOT dropped by default to prevent irreversible loss of archive history.
-- If you explicitly wish to drop the columns as well, uncomment the following line:
--
-- ALTER TABLE public.students
--   DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS is_archived,
--   DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS archived_at,
--   DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS archived_by,
--   DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS archive_reason;

COMMIT;
