from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


FILE_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"^Fee_(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.xlsx$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

PRIMARY_SHEET_ORDER = [
    "Payment Summary & Breakdown",
    "Subject totals (9 & 10)",
    "Subject Totals (XI & XII)",
    "9B",
    "9G",
    "10B",
    "10G",
    "XIB",
    "XIG",
    "XIIB",
    "XIIG",
]

# Old/helper sheets which should not appear in the test UI.
EXCLUDED_SHEETS = {
    "Sheet1",
    "Sheet3",
    "Recheck",
    "Summay (Admin & NTS Staff)",
}

MONTH_NAMES = [
    "January",
    "February",
    "March",
    "April",
    "May",
    "June",
    "July",
    "August",
    "September",
    "October",
    "November",
    "December",
]


def _emit(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    exit_code: int = 0,
) -> None:
    print(
        json.dumps(
            payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        )
    )

    raise SystemExit(exit_code)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""

    text = (
        str(value)
        .replace("\r", " ")
        .replace("\n", " ")
    )

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        text,
    ).strip().lower()


def _is_blank(value: Any) -> bool:
    return (
        value is None
        or (
            isinstance(value, str)
            and value.strip() == ""
        )
    )


def _json_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None:
        return None

    if isinstance(
        value,
        (str, int, float, bool),
    ):
        return value

    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return float(value)

    if isinstance(
        value,
        (datetime, date),
    ):
        return value.isoformat()

    return str(value)


def _to_matrix(
    raw: Any,
) -> list[list[Any]]:
    if raw is None:
        return [[None]]

    if isinstance(raw, tuple):
        if not raw:
            return []

        if isinstance(raw[0], tuple):
            return [
                [
                    _json_value(cell)
                    for cell in row
                ]
                for row in raw
            ]

        return [
            [
                _json_value(cell)
                for cell in raw
            ]
        ]

    return [[_json_value(raw)]]


def _trim_matrix(
    matrix: list[list[Any]],
) -> list[list[Any]]:
    if not matrix:
        return []

    width = max(
        (len(row) for row in matrix),
        default=0,
    )

    rows = [
        row + [None] * (width - len(row))
        for row in matrix
    ]

    # Remove completely blank top rows.
    while rows and all(
        _is_blank(value)
        for value in rows[0]
    ):
        rows.pop(0)

    # Remove completely blank bottom rows.
    while rows and all(
        _is_blank(value)
        for value in rows[-1]
    ):
        rows.pop()

    if not rows:
        return []

    # Remove completely blank left columns.
    while (
        rows
        and rows[0]
        and all(
            _is_blank(row[0])
            for row in rows
        )
    ):
        for row in rows:
            row.pop(0)

    # Remove completely blank right columns.
    while (
        rows
        and rows[0]
        and all(
            _is_blank(row[-1])
            for row in rows
        )
    ):
        for row in rows:
            row.pop()

    return rows


def _file_metadata(
    path: Path,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    match = FILE_PATTERN.match(path.name)

    if match is None:
        return None

    year = int(match.group(1))
    month = int(match.group(2))

    if month < 1 or month > 12:
        return None

    modified = datetime.fromtimestamp(
        path.stat().st_mtime
    ).isoformat(
        timespec="seconds",
    )

    return {
        "fileName": path.name,
        "year": year,
        "month": month,
        "label": (
            f"{MONTH_NAMES[month - 1]} {year}"
        ),
        "modifiedAt": modified,
    }


def _discover_files(
    data_dir: Path,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    data_dir.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    files: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for path in data_dir.iterdir():
        if not path.is_file():
            continue

        metadata = _file_metadata(path)

        if metadata is not None:
            files.append(metadata)

    # Latest month first.
    files.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            int(item["year"]),
            int(item["month"]),
        ),
        reverse=True,
    )

    return files


def _extract_key_metrics(
    matrix: list[list[Any]],
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """
    Reads the TOTAL row from Payment Summary & Breakdown
    by matching labels - NOT fixed row/column positions.
    """

    header_index: int | None = None

    for index, row in enumerate(matrix):
        labels = [
            _normalize_text(value)
            for value in row
        ]

        has_class = "class" in labels

        has_collection = any(
            "total collection" in label
            for label in labels
        )

        if has_class and has_collection:
            header_index = index
            break

    if header_index is None:
        return {}

    header = matrix[header_index]

    columns: dict[str, int] = {}

    for index, value in enumerate(header):
        label = _normalize_text(value)

        if "total collection" in label:
            columns["collection"] = index

        elif label.startswith("teacher"):
            columns["teacher"] = index

        elif "nts" in label:
            columns["nts"] = index

        elif "building" in label:
            columns["building"] = index

        elif label.startswith("admin"):
            columns["admin"] = index

        elif label.startswith("organizer"):
            columns["organizer"] = index

        elif label.startswith("ecc"):
            columns["ecc"] = index

    total_row: list[Any] | None = None

    for row in matrix[
        header_index + 1 :
    ]:
        first_value = next(
            (
                _normalize_text(value)
                for value in row
                if not _is_blank(value)
            ),
            "",
        )

        if first_value == "total":
            total_row = row
            break

    if total_row is None:
        return {}

    metrics: dict[str, float] = {}

    for key, column_index in columns.items():
        if column_index >= len(total_row):
            continue

        value = total_row[column_index]

        if isinstance(value, bool):
            continue

        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            metrics[key] = float(value)

    return metrics


def _read_workbook(
    data_dir: Path,
    file_name: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    # Prevent path traversal.
    safe_name = Path(file_name).name

    if safe_name != file_name:
        raise ValueError(
            "Invalid workbook file name."
        )

    # IMPORTANT:
    # Resolve the file INSIDE Fee_Data first.
    workbook_path = (
        data_dir / safe_name
    ).resolve()

    if not workbook_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Workbook not found: "
            f"{workbook_path}"
        )

    # Metadata must also use the full workbook path.
    metadata = _file_metadata(
        workbook_path
    )

    if metadata is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "Workbook name must use "
            "Fee_YYYY-MM.xlsx format."
        )

    try:
        import pythoncom
        import win32com.client
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "pywin32 is not installed. "
            "Run: "
            ".venv\\Scripts\\python.exe "
            "-m pip install pywin32"
        ) from exc
    
    pythoncom.CoInitialize()

    excel = None
    workbook = None

    try:
        excel = (
            win32com.client.DispatchEx(
                "Excel.Application"
            )
        )

        excel.Visible = False
        excel.DisplayAlerts = False
        excel.ScreenUpdating = False
        excel.EnableEvents = False

        # Disable any workbook macros while reading.
        try:
            excel.AutomationSecurity = 3
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            excel.AskToUpdateLinks = False
        except Exception:
            pass

        workbook = excel.Workbooks.Open(
            str(workbook_path),
            UpdateLinks=0,
            ReadOnly=True,
            IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended=True,
            AddToMru=False,
        )

        try:
            # xlCalculationAutomatic
            excel.Calculation = -4105
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Excel itself performs ALL calculations.
        # Python performs no financial maths.
        excel.CalculateFullRebuild()

        sheets: list[
            dict[str, Any]
        ] = []

        for worksheet in workbook.Worksheets:
            name = str(
                worksheet.Name
            )

            if name in EXCLUDED_SHEETS:
                continue

            used_range = (
                worksheet.UsedRange
            )

            matrix = _trim_matrix(
                _to_matrix(
                    used_range.Value2
                )
            )

            if not matrix:
                continue

            row_count = len(matrix)

            column_count = max(
                (
                    len(row)
                    for row in matrix
                ),
                default=0,
            )

            sheets.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "rowCount": row_count,
                    "columnCount": column_count,
                    "rows": matrix,
                }
            )

        order = {
            name: index
            for index, name
            in enumerate(
                PRIMARY_SHEET_ORDER
            )
        }

        sheets.sort(
            key=lambda item: (
                order.get(
                    str(item["name"]),
                    999,
                ),
                str(item["name"]),
            )
        )

        summary_sheet = next(
            (
                item
                for item in sheets
                if item["name"]
                == "Payment Summary & Breakdown"
            ),
            None,
        )

        metrics = (
            _extract_key_metrics(
                summary_sheet["rows"]
            )
            if summary_sheet
            is not None
            else {}
        )

        return {
            "ok": True,
            "file": metadata,
            "dataDir": str(
                data_dir.resolve()
            ),
            "generatedAt": (
                datetime.now()
                .isoformat(
                    timespec="seconds"
                )
            ),
            "keyMetrics": metrics,
            "sheets": sheets,
        }

    finally:
        if workbook is not None:
            try:
                workbook.Close(
                    SaveChanges=False
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

        if excel is not None:
            try:
                excel.Quit()
            except Exception:
                pass

        pythoncom.CoUninitialize()


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "FG Academy local "
            "Excel fee bridge"
        )
    )

    subparsers = (
        parser.add_subparsers(
            dest="command",
            required=True,
        )
    )

    list_parser = (
        subparsers.add_parser(
            "list",
            help=(
                "List local monthly "
                "fee workbooks"
            ),
        )
    )

    list_parser.add_argument(
        "--data-dir",
        required=True,
    )

    read_parser = (
        subparsers.add_parser(
            "read",
            help=(
                "Read one monthly "
                "fee workbook"
            ),
        )
    )

    read_parser.add_argument(
        "--data-dir",
        required=True,
    )

    read_parser.add_argument(
        "--file",
        required=True,
    )

    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = _parse_args()

    data_dir = (
        Path(args.data_dir)
        .expanduser()
        .resolve()
    )

    try:
        if args.command == "list":
            _emit(
                {
                    "ok": True,
                    "dataDir": str(
                        data_dir
                    ),
                    "files":
                        _discover_files(
                            data_dir
                        ),
                }
            )

        if args.command == "read":
            _emit(
                _read_workbook(
                    data_dir,
                    args.file,
                )
            )

        raise ValueError(
            "Unsupported command."
        )

    except SystemExit:
        raise

    except Exception as exc:
        _emit(
            {
                "ok": False,
                "error": str(exc),
                "errorType":
                    type(exc).__name__,
            },
            exit_code=1,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse
import base64
import calendar
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import warnings

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import dataframe_image as dfi
import pandas as pd
import pywhatkit as kit

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from supabase import Client, create_client


# ============================================================
# WHATSAPP ATTENDANCE AUTOMATION
# ============================================================

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load_dotenv(BASE_DIR / ".env")

ACADEMY_NAME = "FGEIs Evening Coaching Classes"

SUPABASE_URL = os.getenv("SUPABASE_URL", "").strip()
SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY = os.getenv(
    "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", ""
).strip()

SEND_WHATSAPP = os.getenv(
    "SEND_WHATSAPP", "false"
).strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}

WHATSAPP_WAIT_TIME = 20
WHATSAPP_CLOSE_TIME = 5
BETWEEN_GROUPS_DELAY = 5
MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS = 2


def validate_environment():
    if not SUPABASE_URL:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "SUPABASE_URL missing from .env"
        )

    if not SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY missing from .env"
        )

    if SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.startswith(
        "sb_publishable_"
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Publishable key cannot run backend automation. "
            "Use a trusted server-side secret key."
        )

    if SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.count(".") == 2:
        try:
            part = SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.split(".")[1]
            part += "=" * (-len(part) % 4)

            payload = json.loads(
                base64.urlsafe_b64decode(part)
            )

            if payload.get("role") == "anon":
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Anon key cannot run backend automation."
                )

        except RuntimeError:
            raise

        except Exception:
            pass


validate_environment()

supabase: Client = create_client(
    SUPABASE_URL,
    SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY,
)


def pakistan_now():
    return datetime.now(
        ZoneInfo("Asia/Karachi")
    )


def safe_filename(value):
    value = str(value)

    for char in '<>:"/\\|?*':
        value = value.replace(char, "_")

    return "_".join(value.split())


def get_month_details():
    now = pakistan_now()

    year = now.year
    month = now.month

    _, last_day = calendar.monthrange(
        year,
        month,
    )

    start_date = f"{year}-{month:02d}-01"
    end_date = (
        f"{year}-{month:02d}-{last_day:02d}"
    )

    valid_days = [
        day
        for day in range(1, last_day + 1)
        if datetime(year, month, day).weekday() != 6
    ]

    return (
        start_date,
        end_date,
        valid_days,
        now.strftime("%b %Y"),
    )


def get_target_batches(batch_id=None):
    query = (
        supabase.table("batches")
        .select(
            "id, name, whatsapp_group_id"
        )
    )

    if batch_id is not None:
        query = query.eq("id", batch_id)

    result = query.execute()
    rows = result.data or []

    if batch_id is not None and not rows:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Selected batch was not found in Supabase."
        )

    batches = []

    for batch in rows:
        group_id = str(
            batch.get("whatsapp_group_id") or ""
        ).strip()

        if not group_id:
            if batch_id is not None:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Selected batch has no WhatsApp Group ID. "
                    "Configure its group before sending."
                )

            print(
                "Skipping batch without WhatsApp group:",
                batch.get("name"),
            )
            continue

        batches.append(batch)

    return batches


def send_whatsapp_image(
    group_id,
    image_path,
    caption_text,
    batch_name,
):
    for attempt in range(
        1,
        MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS + 1,
    ):
        try:
            print(
                f"WhatsApp attempt {attempt}/"
                f"{MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS}: {batch_name}"
            )

            kit.sendwhats_image(
                receiver=group_id,
                img_path=str(image_path),
                caption=caption_text,
                wait_time=WHATSAPP_WAIT_TIME,
                tab_close=True,
                close_time=WHATSAPP_CLOSE_TIME,
            )

            print(
                "WhatsApp send command completed: "
                f"{batch_name}"
            )

            return True

        except Exception as error:
            print(
                f"WhatsApp failed for {batch_name}: "
                f"{error}"
            )

            if attempt < MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS:
                time.sleep(8)

    return False


def generate_batch_report(
    batch,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    valid_days,
    month_name,
):
    batch_id = batch["id"]
    batch_name = batch["name"]

    print(
        f"Generating report: {batch_name}"
    )

    # Students in selected batch only.
    students_res = (
        supabase.table("students")
        .select("id, name")
        .eq("batch_id", batch_id)
        .order("name")
        .execute()
    )

    students_data = students_res.data or []

    if not students_data:
        print(
            f"No students in {batch_name}. Skipping."
        )
        return None

    students_df = pd.DataFrame(
        students_data
    )

    students_df["Sr No"] = range(
        1,
        len(students_df) + 1,
    )

    students_df.rename(
        columns={
            "name": "Name of Student"
        },
        inplace=True,
    )

    # Monthly attendance for selected batch.
    attendance_res = (
        supabase.table("attendance")
        .select(
            "student_id, date, status"
        )
        .eq("batch_id", batch_id)
        .gte("date", start_date)
        .lte("date", end_date)
        .execute()
    )

    attendance_data = attendance_res.data or []

    if attendance_data:
        attendance_df = pd.DataFrame(
            attendance_data
        )

        attendance_df["status_short"] = (
            attendance_df["status"].map(
                {
                    "present": "P",
                    "absent": "A",
                    "leave": "L",
                }
            )
        )

        attendance_df = attendance_df.dropna(
            subset=["date"]
        ).copy()

        attendance_df["day"] = pd.to_datetime(
            attendance_df["date"]
        ).dt.day.astype(int)

        # UUID prevents same-name students merging.
        pivot_df = attendance_df.pivot_table(
            index="student_id",
            columns="day",
            values="status_short",
            aggfunc="last",
        )

        final_df = students_df[
            [
                "id",
                "Sr No",
                "Name of Student",
            ]
        ].merge(
            pivot_df,
            how="left",
            left_on="id",
            right_index=True,
        )

    else:
        final_df = students_df[
            [
                "id",
                "Sr No",
                "Name of Student",
            ]
        ].copy()

    # UUID should not appear on report.
    final_df.drop(
        columns=["id"],
        inplace=True,
        errors="ignore",
    )

    # Include month dates except Sundays.
    for day in valid_days:
        if day not in final_df.columns:
            final_df[day] = ""

    final_df = final_df[
        [
            "Sr No",
            "Name of Student",
        ] + valid_days
    ].fillna("")

    # Keep existing table design.
    styles = [
        {
            "selector": "table",
            "props": [
                (
                    "border-collapse",
                    "collapse",
                ),
                (
                    "border",
                    "2px solid black",
                ),
                (
                    "min-width",
                    "1250px",
                ),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "th",
            "props": [
                (
                    "border",
                    "1px solid black",
                ),
                (
                    "padding",
                    "10px 15px",
                ),
                (
                    "background-color",
                    "#f0f0f0",
                ),
                (
                    "text-align",
                    "center",
                ),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "td",
            "props": [
                (
                    "border",
                    "1px solid black",
                ),
                (
                    "padding",
                    "10px 15px",
                ),
                (
                    "text-align",
                    "center",
                ),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "tbody tr",
            "props": [
                (
                    "background-color",
                    "white",
                ),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "td:nth-child(2)",
            "props": [
                (
                    "text-align",
                    "left",
                ),
                (
                    "white-space",
                    "nowrap",
                ),
                (
                    "padding-left",
                    "15px",
                ),
                (
                    "min-width",
                    "250px",
                ),
            ],
        },
        {
            "selector": "caption",
            "props": [
                (
                    "caption-side",
                    "top",
                ),
                (
                    "text-align",
                    "center",
                ),
                (
                    "margin-bottom",
                    "20px",
                ),
                (
                    "color",
                    "black",
                ),
            ],
        },
    ]

    caption_html = (
        "<span style='font-size:22px;"
        "font-weight:bold;'>"
        f"{ACADEMY_NAME}"
        "</span>"
        "<hr style='border:0;"
        "border-top:2px solid black;"
        "margin:10px 0;'>"
        "<span style='font-size:22px;"
        "font-weight:bold;'>"
        "Attendance Report for Month of "
        f"{month_name} for {batch_name}"
        "</span>"
    )

    # ========================================================
    # ATTENDANCE COLORS
    # P = GREEN
    # A = RED
    # Other / blank = unchanged
    # ========================================================

    def attendance_cell_style(value):
        if value == "P":
            return (
                "background-color: #DCFCE7; "
                "color: #166534; "
                "font-weight: bold;"
            )

        if value == "A":
            return (
                "background-color: #FEE2E2; "
                "color: #991B1B; "
                "font-weight: bold;"
            )

        return ""

    styled_df = (
        final_df.style
        .set_table_styles(styles)
        .set_caption(caption_html)
        .apply(
            lambda cells: cells.apply(
                lambda col: col.map(
                    attendance_cell_style
                )
            ),
            axis=None,
            subset=valid_days,
        )
        .hide(axis="index")
    )

    filename = (
        f"{safe_filename(batch_name)}_Attendance.png"
    )

    image_path = BASE_DIR / filename

    dfi.export(
        styled_df,
        str(image_path),
        max_cols=-1,
        max_rows=-1,
    )

    print(
        f"Image generated: {image_path}"
    )

    return image_path


def process_batches(batch_id=None):
    print()
    print(
        f"{ACADEMY_NAME} Attendance Automation"
    )

    if batch_id:
        print(
            f"Mode: Single batch ({batch_id})"
        )
    else:
        print("Mode: All batches")

    print(
        "WhatsApp sending:",
        "ENABLED"
        if SEND_WHATSAPP
        else "DISABLED - PNG only",
    )
    print()

    batches = get_target_batches(batch_id)

    if not batches:
        print(
            "No eligible batches were found."
        )
        return

    (
        start_date,
        end_date,
        valid_days,
        month_name,
    ) = get_month_details()

    generated = []
    sent = []
    failed = []
    skipped = []

    total = len(batches)

    for index, batch in enumerate(
        batches,
        start=1,
    ):
        batch_name = batch["name"]

        group_id = str(
            batch["whatsapp_group_id"]
        ).strip()

        print()
        print("=" * 65)
        print(
            f"[{index}/{total}] {batch_name}"
        )
        print("=" * 65)

        try:
            image_path = generate_batch_report(
                batch=batch,
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=end_date,
                valid_days=valid_days,
                month_name=month_name,
            )

            if image_path is None:
                skipped.append(batch_name)
                continue

            generated.append(batch_name)

            if SEND_WHATSAPP:
                caption = (
                    "Assalam o Alaikum,\n"
                    "Please check your child's attendance."
                    f"{batch_name} ({month_name}).\n"
                    f"{ACADEMY_NAME}"
                )

                success = send_whatsapp_image(
                    group_id=group_id,
                    image_path=image_path,
                    caption_text=caption,
                    batch_name=batch_name,
                )

                if success:
                    sent.append(batch_name)
                else:
                    failed.append(batch_name)

            if SEND_WHATSAPP and index < total:
                print(
                    f"Waiting {BETWEEN_GROUPS_DELAY}s "
                    "before next batch..."
                )
                time.sleep(
                    BETWEEN_GROUPS_DELAY
                )

        except Exception as error:
            print(
                f"Failed to process {batch_name}: "
                f"{error}"
            )
            failed.append(batch_name)

    print()
    print("=" * 65)
    print("AUTOMATION FINISHED")
    print("=" * 65)

    print(
        f"Reports generated: {len(generated)}"
    )

    if SEND_WHATSAPP:
        print(
            f"Send commands completed: {len(sent)}"
        )
        print(f"Failed: {len(failed)}")

    print(f"Skipped: {len(skipped)}")

    for name in failed:
        print(f"FAILED: {name}")

    for name in skipped:
        print(f"SKIPPED: {name}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Academy attendance WhatsApp automation"
        )
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--batch-id",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help=(
            "UUID of one batch. Omit to process all."
        ),
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.batch_id:
        try:
            UUID(args.batch_id)

        except ValueError:
            parser.error(
                "--batch-id must be a valid batch UUID."
            )

    # Prevent simultaneous Windows automations.
    lock_file = BASE_DIR / "automation.lock"

    with open(lock_file, "a+b") as lock:
        if os.name == "nt":
            import msvcrt

            lock.seek(0)

            if lock.read(1) == b"":
                lock.seek(0)
                lock.write(b"0")
                lock.flush()

            lock.seek(0)

            try:
                msvcrt.locking(
                    lock.fileno(),
                    msvcrt.LK_NBLCK,
                    1,
                )

            except OSError:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Another WhatsApp automation is running. "
                    "Finish it before starting another."
                )

        try:
            process_batches(args.batch_id)

        finally:
            if os.name == "nt":
                lock.seek(0)

                msvcrt.locking(
                    lock.fileno(),
                    msvcrt.LK_UNLCK,
                    1,
                )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()

    except Exception as error:
        print()
        print("AUTOMATION STOPPED")
        print(f"Reason: {error}")
        print(
            "Check .env, Supabase, Python environment, "
            "WhatsApp Web and internet connection."
        )
        sys.exit(1)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


CLASS_SHEETS = [
    "9B",
    "9G",
    "10B",
    "10G",
    "XIB",
    "XIG",
    "XIIB",
    "XIIG",
]

SUMMARY_SHEETS = [
    "Payment Summary & Breakdown",
    "Subject totals (9 & 10)",
    "Subject Totals (XI & XII)",
]


def normalize(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""

    return re.sub(
        r"\s+",
        " ",
        str(value).replace("\n", " "),
    ).strip().lower()


def col_letter(number: int) -> str:
    result = ""

    while number:
        number, remainder = divmod(
            number - 1,
            26,
        )

        result = (
            chr(65 + remainder)
            + result
        )

    return result


def find_header_column(
    ws,
    wanted: str,
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    wanted = normalize(wanted)

    for row in range(1, 11):
        for col in range(1, 31):
            value = normalize(
                ws.Cells(row, col).Value2
            )

            if value == wanted:
                return row, col

    raise RuntimeError(
        f"{ws.Name}: "
        f"'{wanted}' header not found."
    )


def snapshot_formulas(ws) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}

    used = ws.UsedRange

    first_row = used.Row
    first_col = used.Column

    last_row = (
        first_row
        + used.Rows.Count
        - 1
    )

    last_col = (
        first_col
        + used.Columns.Count
        - 1
    )

    for row in range(
        first_row,
        last_row + 1,
    ):
        for col in range(
            first_col,
            last_col + 1,
        ):
            cell = ws.Cells(
                row,
                col,
            )

            try:
                has_formula = bool(
                    cell.HasFormula
                )
            except Exception:
                has_formula = False

            if not has_formula:
                continue

            value = cell.Value2

            # Build address ourselves.
            # Example: A1, D15, AA42
            address = (
                f"{col_letter(col)}{row}"
            )

            result[address] = value

    return result

def compare_snapshots(
    before: dict[str, Any],
    after: dict[str, Any],
    sheet_name: str,
) -> list[str]:
    problems: list[str] = []
  
    addresses = set(before) | set(after)

    for address in sorted(addresses):
        old = before.get(address)
        new = after.get(address)

        if isinstance(
            old,
            (int, float),
        ) and isinstance(
            new,
            (int, float),
        ):
            if abs(
                float(old)
                - float(new)
            ) > 0.01:
                problems.append(
                    f"{sheet_name}!{address}: "
                    f"{old} -> {new}"
                )

            continue

        if old != new:
            problems.append(
                f"{sheet_name}!{address}: "
                f"{old!r} -> {new!r}"
            )

    return problems


def get_formula(cell) -> str | None:
    try:
        formula = cell.Formula2

        if isinstance(
            formula,
            str,
        ) and formula.startswith("="):
            return formula
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        formula = cell.Formula

        if isinstance(
            formula,
            str,
        ) and formula.startswith("="):
            return formula
    except Exception:
        pass

    return None


def set_formula(
    cell,
    formula: str,
) -> None:
    try:
        cell.Formula2 = formula
        return
    except Exception:
        pass

    cell.Formula = formula


def replace_fee_references(
    formula: str,
    source_column: str,
    counted_column: str,
) -> str:
    source = re.escape(
        source_column
    )

    # Examples:
    # D3
    # $D$3
    # D$3
    # $D3
    cell_pattern = re.compile(
        rf"(?<![A-Z0-9_])"
        rf"(\$?){source}"
        rf"(\$?\d+)"
        rf"(?![A-Z0-9_])",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    result = cell_pattern.sub(
        lambda match:
            f"{match.group(1)}"
            f"{counted_column}"
            f"{match.group(2)}",
        formula,
    )

    # Whole-column references if any.
    whole_column_pattern = re.compile(
        rf"(?<![A-Z0-9_])"
        rf"(\$?){source}:"
        rf"(\$?){source}"
        rf"(?![A-Z0-9_])",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    result = whole_column_pattern.sub(
        lambda match:
            f"{match.group(1)}"
            f"{counted_column}:"
            f"{match.group(2)}"
            f"{counted_column}",
        result,
    )

    return result


def is_number(
    value: Any,
) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(value, (int, float))
        and not isinstance(value, bool)
    )


def migrate_sheet(
    ws,
    excel,
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    header_row, fee_col = (
        find_header_column(
            ws,
            "fees",
        )
    )

    _, name_col = (
        find_header_column(
            ws,
            "name",
        )
    )

    # Prevent accidental double migration.
    header_values = {}

    for col in range(1, 40):
        text = normalize(
            ws.Cells(
                header_row,
                col,
            ).Value2
        )

        if text:
            header_values[text] = col

    already_status = (
        "status"
        in header_values
    )

    already_counted = (
        "counted_fee"
        in header_values
    )

    if already_status or already_counted:
        if (
            already_status
            and already_counted
        ):
            print(
                f"[SKIP] "
                f"{ws.Name}: "
                f"already migrated."
            )

            return 0, 0

        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{ws.Name}: "
            "partially migrated workbook "
            "detected."
        )

    fee_letter = col_letter(
        fee_col
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Insert STATUS + REMARKS immediately after FEES.
    # Excel itself updates shifted formulas/references.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    ws.Columns(
        fee_col + 1
    ).EntireColumn.Insert()

    ws.Columns(
        fee_col + 2
    ).EntireColumn.Insert()

    status_col = fee_col + 1
    remarks_col = fee_col + 2

    ws.Cells(
        header_row,
        status_col,
    ).Value2 = "STATUS"

    ws.Cells(
        header_row,
        remarks_col,
    ).Value2 = "REMARKS"

    # Copy header formatting from FEES.
    try:
        ws.Cells(
            header_row,
            fee_col,
        ).Copy()

        ws.Cells(
            header_row,
            status_col,
        ).PasteSpecial(-4122)

        ws.Cells(
            header_row,
            fee_col,
        ).Copy()

        ws.Cells(
            header_row,
            remarks_col,
        ).PasteSpecial(-4122)

        excel.CutCopyMode = False

        ws.Cells(
            header_row,
            status_col,
        ).Value2 = "STATUS"

        ws.Cells(
            header_row,
            remarks_col,
        ).Value2 = "REMARKS"
    except Exception:
        pass

    ws.Columns(
        status_col
    ).ColumnWidth = 12

    ws.Columns(
        remarks_col
    ).ColumnWidth = 22

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Hidden helper columns at far right.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    used = ws.UsedRange

    used_last_col = (
        used.Column
        + used.Columns.Count
        - 1
    )

    counted_col = (
        used_last_col + 1
    )

    portal_id_col = (
        counted_col + 1
    )

    ws.Cells(
        header_row,
        counted_col,
    ).Value2 = "COUNTED_FEE"

    ws.Cells(
        header_row,
        portal_id_col,
    ).Value2 = "PORTAL_STUDENT_ID"

    ws.Columns(
        counted_col
    ).Hidden = True

    ws.Columns(
        portal_id_col
    ).Hidden = True

    counted_letter = col_letter(
        counted_col
    )

    status_letter = col_letter(
        status_col
    )

    fee_letter = col_letter(
        fee_col
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify real student rows.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    used = ws.UsedRange

    last_row = (
        used.Row
        + used.Rows.Count
        - 1
    )

    student_rows: list[int] = []

    for row in range(
        header_row + 1,
        last_row + 1,
    ):
        name = ws.Cells(
            row,
            name_col,
        ).Value2

        fee = ws.Cells(
            row,
            fee_col,
        ).Value2

        if (
            normalize(name)
            and is_number(fee)
        ):
            student_rows.append(row)

    if not student_rows:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{ws.Name}: "
            "no student rows found."
        )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # September migration:
    # all current students start as PAID.
    #
    # COUNTED_FEE:
    # Paid   -> FEES
    # Unpaid -> 0
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    for row in student_rows:
        status_cell = ws.Cells(
            row,
            status_col,
        )

        status_cell.Value2 = "Paid"

        try:
            status_cell.Validation.Delete()
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            status_cell.Validation.Add(
                3,  # xlValidateList
                1,  # xlValidAlertStop
                1,  # xlBetween
                "Paid,Unpaid",
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        counted_formula = (
            f'=IF('
            f'LOWER(TRIM('
            f'{status_letter}{row}'
            f'))="paid",'
            f'{fee_letter}{row},'
            f'0)'
        )

        set_formula(
            ws.Cells(
                row,
                counted_col,
            ),
            counted_formula,
        )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Redirect existing financial formulas:
    #
    # old:
    # =D3:D48*0.6
    #
    # new:
    # =Q3:Q48*0.6
    #
    # Only local formulas are changed.
    # External sheet references are left alone.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    used = ws.UsedRange

    first_row = used.Row
    first_col = used.Column

    last_row = (
        first_row
        + used.Rows.Count
        - 1
    )

    last_col = (
        first_col
        + used.Columns.Count
        - 1
    )

    rewritten = 0

    for row in range(
        first_row,
        last_row + 1,
    ):
        for col in range(
            first_col,
            last_col + 1,
        ):
            if col in (
                counted_col,
                portal_id_col,
            ):
                continue

            cell = ws.Cells(
                row,
                col,
            )

            formula = get_formula(
                cell
            )

            if not formula:
                continue

            # Class sheets are expected to use
            # local calculations. Don't touch
            # external references.
            if "!" in formula:
                continue

            updated = (
                replace_fee_references(
                    formula,
                    fee_letter,
                    counted_letter,
                )
            )

            if updated != formula:
                set_formula(
                    cell,
                    updated,
                )

                rewritten += 1

    if rewritten == 0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{ws.Name}: "
            "no fee formulas were redirected."
        )

    print(
        f"[OK] {ws.Name}: "
        f"{len(student_rows)} students, "
        f"{rewritten} formulas updated."
    )

    return (
        len(student_rows),
        rewritten,
    )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()

    parser.add_argument(
        "--file",
        required=True,
        help=(
            "Path to monthly "
            "Excel workbook."
        ),
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    workbook_path = Path(
        args.file
    ).resolve()

    if not workbook_path.exists():
        print(
            f"ERROR: File not found: "
            f"{workbook_path}"
        )

        raise SystemExit(1)

    try:
        import pythoncom
        import win32com.client
    except ImportError:
        print(
            "ERROR: pywin32 missing."
        )

        raise SystemExit(1)

    pythoncom.CoInitialize()

    excel = None
    workbook = None

    try:
        excel = (
            win32com.client.DispatchEx(
                "Excel.Application"
            )
        )

        excel.Visible = False
        excel.DisplayAlerts = False
        excel.ScreenUpdating = False
        excel.EnableEvents = False

        workbook = (
            excel.Workbooks.Open(
                str(workbook_path),
                UpdateLinks=0,
                ReadOnly=False,
                IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended=True,
                AddToMru=False,
            )
        )

        print(
            f"Workbook: "
            f"{workbook_path}"
        )

        print(
            "\nCalculating original workbook..."
        )

        excel.CalculateFullRebuild()

        # Snapshot summary values BEFORE change.
        before = {}

        for name in SUMMARY_SHEETS:
            before[name] = (
                snapshot_formulas(
                    workbook.Worksheets(
                        name
                    )
                )
            )

        total_students = 0
        total_formulas = 0

        print(
            "\nMigrating class sheets...\n"
        )

        for sheet_name in CLASS_SHEETS:
            ws = workbook.Worksheets(
                sheet_name
            )

            students, formulas = (
                migrate_sheet(
                    ws,
                    excel,
                )
            )

            total_students += students
            total_formulas += formulas

        print(
            "\nRecalculating migrated workbook..."
        )

        excel.CalculateFullRebuild()

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Verify summary outputs did NOT change.
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        problems: list[str] = []

        for name in SUMMARY_SHEETS:
            after = snapshot_formulas(
                workbook.Worksheets(
                    name
                )
            )

            problems.extend(
                compare_snapshots(
                    before[name],
                    after,
                    name,
                )
            )

        if problems:
            print(
                "\nVERIFICATION FAILED."
            )

            print(
                "Workbook will NOT be saved.\n"
            )

            for problem in problems[:30]:
                print(
                    f" - {problem}"
                )

            raise RuntimeError(
                "Financial totals changed "
                "during migration."
            )

        print(
            "\nVerification PASSED."
        )

        print(
            "Existing summary values "
            "are unchanged."
        )

        workbook.Save()

        print(
            "\n=================================="
        )

        print(
            "MIGRATION SUCCESSFUL"
        )

        print(
            "=================================="
        )

        print(
            f"Students migrated: "
            f"{total_students}"
        )

        print(
            f"Formulas redirected: "
            f"{total_formulas}"
        )

        print(
            f"Saved: {workbook_path}"
        )

        print(
            "\nPaid = counted in calculations"
        )

        print(
            "Unpaid = zero in calculations"
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        print(
            f"\nERROR: {exc}"
        )

        if workbook is not None:
            try:
                workbook.Close(
                    SaveChanges=False
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

            workbook = None

        raise SystemExit(1)

    finally:
        if workbook is not None:
            try:
                workbook.Close(
                    SaveChanges=False
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

        if excel is not None:
            try:
                excel.Quit()
            except Exception:
                pass

        pythoncom.CoUninitialize()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: Build Academy Portal

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: academy-portal-release
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # ==========================================================
  # ANDROID APK
  # ==========================================================
  build-android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    outputs:
      version_code: ${{ steps.android_version.outputs.version_code }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "3.38.3"
          channel: stable

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      # Restore the permanent release signing key.
      - name: Restore Permanent Signing Key
        shell: bash
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          printf '%s' "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" \
            | base64 --decode \
            > android/app/fgacademy-release.jks

          if [ ! -s android/app/fgacademy-release.jks ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Signing keystore is empty."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Permanent signing keystore restored."

      # Increase Android versionCode automatically.
      - name: Calculate Android Build Number
        id: android_version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "version_code=$((10000 + GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER))" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # Uses release signing configured in:
      # android/app/build.gradle.kts
      - name: Build Signed Release APK
        shell: bash
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          flutter build apk --release \
            --build-number="${{ steps.android_version.outputs.version_code }}" \
            --dart-define="GITHUB_REPOSITORY=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      - name: Prepare APK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          cp \
            build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk \
            FG_Academy_Portal.apk

          test -s FG_Academy_Portal.apk

      # CRITICAL:
      # Block releases signed with Android Debug or any
      # certificate other than our permanent release key.
      - name: Verify APK Signature
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          SDK_DIR="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-}}"

          if [ -z "$SDK_DIR" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Android SDK location unavailable."
            exit 1
          fi

          APKSIGNER="$(
            find "$SDK_DIR/build-tools" \
              -type f -name apksigner \
              | sort -V \
              | tail -n 1
          )"

          if [ -z "$APKSIGNER" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: apksigner not found."
            exit 1
          fi

          CERT_INFO="$(
            "$APKSIGNER" verify \
              --print-certs FG_Academy_Portal.apk
          )"

          echo "$CERT_INFO"

          # SHA-256 of permanent fgacademy-release.jks key.
          EXPECTED_SHA256="e832b0dd9b8726fc4b35c84bbe3d14737fef614041c5bed36856649236884274"

          if ! echo "$CERT_INFO" \
              | grep -qiF "$EXPECTED_SHA256"; then

            echo ""
            echo "========================================"
            echo "ERROR: WRONG APK SIGNING CERTIFICATE!"
            echo "Expected permanent signing key."
            echo "Debug-signed APK will NOT be released."
            echo "========================================"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "========================================"
          echo "SUCCESS: Permanent APK signing verified."
          echo "========================================"

      - name: Upload APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Android-APK
          path: FG_Academy_Portal.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

  # ==========================================================
  # WINDOWS DESKTOP APP
  # ==========================================================
  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "3.38.3"
          channel: stable

      - name: Enable Windows Desktop Support
        run: flutter config --enable-windows-desktop

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Build Windows Release
        run: flutter build windows --release

      # Include WhatsApp and Excel backend.
      - name: Add Local Automation Backend
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $release = "build\windows\x64\runner\Release"
          $backend = "$release\FGEI_Backend"
          $feeData = "$release\Fee_Data"

          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $backend
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $feeData

          Copy-Item "FGEI_Backend\main.py" `
            "$backend\main.py" -Force

          Copy-Item "FGEI_Backend\main.bat" `
            "$backend\main.bat" -Force

          Copy-Item "FGEI_Backend\setup_backend.bat" `
            "$backend\setup_backend.bat" -Force

          Copy-Item "FGEI_Backend\requirements.txt" `
            "$backend\requirements.txt" -Force

          Copy-Item "FGEI_Backend\fee_excel_bridge.py" `
            "$backend\fee_excel_bridge.py" -Force

          @"
          Academy Portal - Local Fee Data

          Put monthly Excel workbooks in this folder.

          Required naming:
          Fee_2026-09.xlsx
          Fee_2026-10.xlsx
          Fee_2026-11.xlsx

          Excel workbooks are intentionally NOT included
          in the GitHub release.
          "@ | Set-Content "$feeData\PUT_FEE_FILES_HERE.txt"

          Write-Host "Backend files:"
          Get-ChildItem $backend

          Write-Host "Fee data folder:"
          Get-ChildItem $feeData

      - name: Create Windows ZIP
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          Compress-Archive `
            -Path "build\windows\x64\runner\Release\*" `
            -DestinationPath "Academy_Portal_Windows.zip" `
            -Force

      - name: Upload Windows ZIP Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Windows-ZIP
          path: Academy_Portal_Windows.zip
          if-no-files-found: error

  # ==========================================================
  # PUBLISH LATEST GITHUB RELEASE
  # ==========================================================
  create-release:
    needs:
      - build-android
      - build-windows

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Download Android APK
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Android-APK
          path: release-assets/android

      - name: Download Windows ZIP
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Windows-ZIP
          path: release-assets/windows

      - name: Create Latest Release
        uses: ncipollo/release-action@v1
        with:
          artifacts: "release-assets/android/FG_Academy_Portal.apk,release-assets/windows/Academy_Portal_Windows.zip"

          artifactErrorsFailBuild: true

          # Unique release tag for automatic update detection.
          tag: "android-${{ needs.build-android.outputs.version_code }}"

          commit: ${{ github.sha }}

          name: "Academy Portal - Latest Update"

          body: |
            Latest Academy Portal release.

            Downloads:
            - FG_Academy_Portal.apk
            - Academy_Portal_Windows.zip

            Windows package includes:
            - WhatsApp Attendance Automation
            - Individual Batch Reporting
            - Excel Fees Backend
            - Empty Fee_Data folder

            Local .env files and financial Excel workbooks
            are intentionally not included.

          allowUpdates: true
          makeLatest: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

FILE START: docs/Academy_Antigravity_Final_Changes_Prompt.txt

You are working in my existing, LIVE Flutter Academy Portal repository (Android, Windows, and Vercel Web). I want one final, narrowly scoped cleanup release. Read the whole current project carefully; do not assume an older codebase dump is the latest version.

IMPORTANT REFERENCES
- docs/Academy_Supabase_Schema_Reference.json is a supplied snapshot of the database schema (tables, columns, RLS, functions, triggers, constraints, views). Read it completely to understand relations. It may be stale: inspect the actual current migrations/current schema and compare. If Supabase read-only MCP is connected, inspect the LIVE SCHEMA only; do not query student personal data or execute writes. A Supabase URL alone does NOT grant private schema access.
- docs/Academy_Portal_Final_Cleanup.sql is a proposed one-transaction migration. REVIEW every statement against the ACTUAL CURRENT schema before running it. Do not execute it for me, and do not modify the production database automatically. Report schema drift and dependencies first.
- Keep existing auth, admin/teacher permissions, responsive layouts, award lists, attendance, WhatsApp reporting and GitHub/Vercel deployment working.

FIRST: READ-ONLY PLAN
1. Identify every live Flutter and backend reference to fees (`fee_*`, `default_fee`, `fee_remarks`, Fees screens, Excel fees bridge/Python code, fee reports/PDF, `admin_add_fee_student` etc.) and every student ADD, DELETE, SELECT, attendance history and award/student listing route. Search all the current repository files, not only known paths.
2. Identify the exact files, RPC contracts, database migrations and potential compatibility risks. Explain your plan before editing. Keep a small, reviewed diff; ask me to approve risky deletions.
3. Supabase schema relationships to preserve: `students.id` UUID; `students.batch_id` -> `batches`; `students.stream` text[] subject codes; `attendance.student_id` -> `students.id` with ON DELETE CASCADE; `award_marks.student_id` -> `students.id` with ON DELETE CASCADE; `award_tests`, `teacher_assignments`, `user_profiles` and Supabase Auth must remain intact.

CHANGE A — REMOVE ALL FEES FROM THE APP
- No Fees tab in the sidebar or bottom navigation; no Fees card / Excel Fees Test anywhere on the dashboard; no Fee, default amount, payment month or Fee remarks fields in Add/Edit Student.
- Remove ALL unreachable fee-specific Flutter screens/models/services/PDF builders/Excel bridge code and Python fee integration, but only if no remaining code imports or depends on them. Do not remove the separate attendance WhatsApp Python backend.
- Add Student must no longer depend on `FeeService.addStudent` or `admin_add_fee_student` / `add_fee_student` fee RPCs. Use the fee-free new `portal_add_student(p_name, p_batch_id, p_subjects)` RPC specified in the SQL migration. The old teacher attendance-add RPC `portal_add_student_from_attendance_v2` will be replaced on the server to call the new fee-free implementation.
- Keep other features, navigation, notifications, sign-in, teacher permissions, award sheets, daily attendance and existing responsive Web + Android + Windows UI unchanged unless necessary.

CHANGE B — ARCHIVE INSTEAD OF DELETE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
- In `lib/screens/admin/students_tab.dart` and every other student delete flow, replace hard DELETE with an admin-only `archive_student(p_student_id, p_reason)` RPC. No `.from('students').delete()` anywhere in runtime code.
- Rename destructive UI to `Archive Student`, show a confirmation stating historical attendance and award marks WILL BE RETAINED, and optionally collect a short reason (e.g. Left academy).
- Add an **Archive** section/tab within Admin Students, NOT a new left sidebar tab. Show archived students with name, batch, archived date/reason, searchable and sorted. Add `Restore` with confirmation; call `restore_student(p_student_id)`. The SAME UUID must be restored and history preserved. Admin only; teacher must not access archive list.
- Every ACTIVE student query must use `.eq('is_archived', false)` (or equivalent). Every archive query must use `.eq('is_archived', true)`. Filter in Admin and Teacher attendance lists, student counts, award-list student picker, add/edit forms, student search, report generation and every appropriate metric. Do not silently erase older attendance/award rows. Show archived student's historical attendance and marks in the Admin Archive detail (read-only) so disputes about prior dates can be resolved.
- Look for code paths deleting batches (which can also cascade). Existing database migration blocks batch hard delete; remove/rework any destructive UI route.
- If a matching-name student is archived, guide the admin to Restore instead of creating a duplicate. No attempt to recreate previously hard-deleted history.
- For historical reporting, clearly distinguish CURRENT ACTIVE population from HISTORICAL past-period records; do not falsify historic attendance or mark archived students absent going forward.
- Ensure attendance automation backend (`FGEI_Backend/main.py`, and alternate main_single_tab.py if present) excludes archived students when selecting current attendance and calculating unmarked counts. Preserve existing 'Send All only if today's unmarked count is zero' business rule and individual batch sending behavior. Do NOT change WhatsApp sending transport as part of this task.

CHANGE C — STREAM / SUBJECT SELECTION IS MANDATORY
- On EVERY Add Student entry point (Admin Students, Admin Attendance, Teacher Attendance, dialogs and RPCs), the Save button must refuse empty `stream` / selected subjects. Show 'Select at least one subject before adding the student.'
- Preserve existing Class 9/10 subject choice rules (Computer and Biology alternative) and Class 11/12 limits. Teacher must include an assigned teaching subject; existing DB `validate_student_subject_stream()` trigger already checks valid choices; confirm it remains.
- Do not silently auto-fill unspecified subjects. Show chosen stream clearly in the student list and relevant teacher views.
- Existing student `stream` fields are already NOT NULL with validation according to supplied schema snapshot. Validate any legacy anomalies and report; do not fabricate or overwrite subjects.

DATABASE + SECURITY
- Supabase SQL is delivered separately, not to be executed by you until I approve. Actual current schema may differ from the snapshot.
- New `students` fields: `is_archived` (default false), `archived_at`, `archived_by`, `archive_reason`. Existing `students.status` ('enrolled'/'trial') is unrelated and must be preserved.
- Migration removes all `fee_*` views/tables/functions and `students.default_fee`/`students.fee_remarks`. Check grants, triggers, RLS, dependent functions before any drop. Protect all existing student, attendance and award data. Old APK clients using the removed fee RPCs may require an update.
- Admin-only archive and restore enforced on server using `public.is_portal_admin()`, secured SECURITY DEFINER functions and explicit execute grants. Do NOT use the Supabase service-role or secret key in Flutter/Web.
- Do not set RLS to public, loosen permissions, change signup or remove existing teacher permissions.

-- ACADEMY PORTAL: FINAL CLEANUP (based on exported Supabase schema snapshot)
-- IMPORTANT: Run only after backing up the live DB and preparing updated clients.
-- Removes fee tables/views/functions + student fee fields, adds archive protection.
-- The transaction rolls back if a dependency prevents a safe DROP (NO CASCADE).
BEGIN;

-- 1) Archive metadata. Keep current status ('enrolled' / 'trial') independent.
ALTER TABLE public.students
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived_at timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archived_by uuid,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS archive_reason text;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_students_active_batch
  ON public.students (batch_id, name) WHERE is_archived = false;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_students_archived
  ON public.students (archived_at DESC) WHERE is_archived = true;

-- Preserve both attendance and marks; hard DELETE of a student is forbidden.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_student_hard_delete()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student deletion disabled. Archive the student instead.'
    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$$;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_student_hard_delete ON public.students;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_student_hard_delete
  BEFORE DELETE ON public.students FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_student_hard_delete();

-- Batch deletion can cascade to students/attendance/award tests: block too.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_batch_hard_delete()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Batch deletion disabled to preserve attendance and award history.'
    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$$;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_batch_hard_delete ON public.batches;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_batch_hard_delete
  BEFORE DELETE ON public.batches FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_batch_hard_delete();

-- 2) Admin-only archive/restore RPCs. No historical row or student UUID changes.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.archive_student(
  p_student_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT 'Left academy'
) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only an active admin can archive students.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.students
     SET is_archived = true,
         archived_at = now(),
         archived_by = auth.uid(),
         archive_reason = left(nullif(btrim(p_reason), ''), 500)
   WHERE id = p_student_id AND is_archived = false;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student not found or already archived.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_student(
  p_student_id uuid
) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only an active admin can restore students.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.students
     SET is_archived = false,
         archived_at = null,
         archived_by = null,
         archive_reason = null
   WHERE id = p_student_id AND is_archived = true;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student not found or not archived.';
  END IF;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.archive_student(uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.restore_student(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.archive_student(uuid,text) TO authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.restore_student(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- Teacher cannot fetch archived students through normal student SELECT.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS students_select_portal ON public.students;
CREATE POLICY students_select_portal ON public.students
  FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_portal_admin()
    OR (is_archived = false AND public.can_access_batch(batch_id))
  );

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS students_delete_admin ON public.students;
REVOKE DELETE ON public.students FROM anon, authenticated;

-- Teachers cannot mark NEW attendance for archived students.
-- The existing admin override still permits looking up historic records.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_manage_attendance(
  p_student_id uuid, p_batch_id uuid
) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
    WHERE s.id = p_student_id
      AND s.batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND s.is_archived = false
      AND public.can_access_batch(p_batch_id)
  );
$$;

-- 3) Fee-free student creation; subject/stream selection MUST be non-empty.
-- Preserves existing behavior: new student receives today's Present attendance.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portal_add_student(
  p_name text, p_batch_id uuid, p_subjects text[]
) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_name text := btrim(coalesce(p_name, ''));
  v_class_level smallint;
  v_student_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Please log in first.' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF v_name = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student name is required.';
  END IF;
  IF p_subjects IS NULL OR cardinality(p_subjects) < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Select at least one subject/stream.';
  END IF;
  SELECT b.class_level INTO v_class_level
    FROM public.batches b WHERE b.id = p_batch_id;
  IF v_class_level IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid batch.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (public.is_portal_admin() OR public.can_access_batch(p_batch_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not allowed to add a student to this batch.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.teacher_assignments ta
    WHERE ta.teacher_id = auth.uid()
      AND ta.class_level = v_class_level
      AND ta.subject_code = ANY(p_subjects)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Include your assigned subject in the selected stream.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.students s
    WHERE s.batch_id = p_batch_id
      AND lower(btrim(s.name)) = lower(v_name)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Name exists in this batch (check Archive for a restore).';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.students (name,batch_id,stream,status)
  VALUES (v_name,p_batch_id,p_subjects,'enrolled')
  RETURNING id INTO v_student_id;
  INSERT INTO public.attendance (student_id,batch_id,date,status)
  VALUES (v_student_id,p_batch_id,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Karachi')::date,'present')
  ON CONFLICT (student_id,date)
  DO UPDATE SET batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id, status = 'present';
  RETURN v_student_id;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.portal_add_student(text,uuid,text[]) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.portal_add_student(text,uuid,text[]) TO authenticated;

-- Backward-compatible teacher attendance-add RPC, now with NO fee action.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_from_attendance_v2(
  p_name text, p_batch_id uuid, p_subjects text[]
) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = ''
AS $$
  SELECT public.portal_add_student(p_name,p_batch_id,p_subjects);
$$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_from_attendance_v2(text,uuid,text[]) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_from_attendance_v2(text,uuid,text[]) TO authenticated;

-- 4) Remove ALL known fee reporting views in dependency order, without CASCADE.
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_ecc_balance;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_staff_summary;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_final_summary;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_ssc_subject_summary;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_hssc_subject_summary;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_class_totals;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_class_student_rows;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_summary_totals;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fee_financial_reports;

-- Only user-facing trigger on students which writes to fee_payments.
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_sync_unpaid_fee_subject_stream ON public.students;

-- Remove fee tables (financial data is PERMANENTLY deleted; keep a backup).
-- DROP is intentionally without CASCADE: unexpected dependencies force rollback.
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_payments;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_staff_payment_overrides;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_staff_allocations;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_month_teacher_assignments;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_month_distribution_settings;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_teacher_assignments;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_distribution_settings;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.fee_audit_month_settings;

-- Remove fee-only stored procedures/functions (exact exported signatures).
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_add_fee_student(text,uuid,numeric,text[],text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.add_fee_student(text,uuid,numeric,text[],text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_initialize_fee_month(text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.initialize_fee_month(text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_set_fee_payment_status(uuid,text,text,numeric);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.set_fee_payment_status(uuid,text,text,numeric);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_reset_fee_staff_payment(text,text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_set_student_fee_remarks(uuid,text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_set_fee_staff_payment(text,text,numeric);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_update_fee_distribution(text,numeric,numeric,numeric,numeric,numeric,numeric);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_update_fee_teacher_name(text,text,text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_ensure_fee_month_setup(text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_update_fee_month_distribution(text,text,numeric,numeric,numeric,numeric,numeric,numeric);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.admin_update_fee_month_teacher_name(text,text,text,text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.fee_report_class_code(smallint,text);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.fee_report_group_label(smallint,text[]);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.fee_report_group_order(smallint,text[]);
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.set_fee_payment_updated_at();
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.sync_fee_payment_batch();
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.snapshot_fee_payment_subject_stream();
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.sync_unpaid_fee_subject_stream();

-- Student identity, attendance, marks, subjects and batch are preserved.
ALTER TABLE public.students
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS default_fee,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS fee_remarks;

-- Defensive: if schema drift introduced unknown fee objects, fail and ROLLBACK.
DO $$
DECLARE v_left text;
BEGIN
  SELECT string_agg(s, ', ') INTO v_left FROM (
    SELECT 'table/view:' || c.relname AS s
      FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
     WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
       AND c.relname LIKE 'fee\_%' ESCAPE '\'
       AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','p','f')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'function:' || p.proname AS s
      FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
     WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname LIKE '%fee%'
  ) d;
  IF v_left IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unrecognized fee objects remain: %. Transaction rolled back.', v_left;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

COMMIT;

-- Read-only check. Previously deleted student rows are NOT restored by this migration.
SELECT is_archived, count(*) AS students
  FROM public.students GROUP BY is_archived ORDER BY is_archived;

v_class_level SMALLINT;\r\n\r\n    v_invalid_count INTEGER;\r\n\r\n    v_distinct_count INTEGER;\r\n\r\n    v_max_subjects INTEGER;\r\n\r\n    v_has_comp BOOLEAN;\r\n\r\n    v_has_bio BOOLEAN;\r\nBEGIN\r\n\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n    -- BATCH / CLASS\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n    SELECT b.class_level\r\n    INTO v_class_level\r\n    FROM public.batches b\r\n    WHERE b.id = NEW.batch_id;\r\n\r\n\r\n    IF v_class_level IS NULL THEN\r\n        RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n            'Selected batch has no valid class level.';\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    IF v_class_level NOT IN (9, 10, 11, 12) THEN\r\n        RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n            'Only Classes 9 to 12 are supported.';\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n    -- AT LEAST ONE SUBJECT\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n    IF NEW.stream IS NULL\r\n       OR cardinality(NEW.stream) < 1\r\n    THEN\r\n        RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n            'At least one subject must be selected for %.',\r\n            NEW.name;\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n    -- ALLOWED SUBJECT CODES ONLY\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n    SELECT\r\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (\r\n            WHERE u.subject_code NOT IN (\r\n                'Phy',\r\n                'Chem',\r\n                'Math',\r\n                'Eng',\r\n                'Comp',\r\n                'Bio'\r\n            )\r\n        ),\r\n        COUNT(DISTINCT u.subject_code)\r\n\r\n    INTO\r\n        v_invalid_count,\r\n        v_distinct_count\r\n\r\n    FROM unnest(NEW.stream)\r\n        AS u(subject_code);\r\n\r\n\r\n    IF v_invalid_count > 0 THEN\r\n        RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n            'Invalid subject code detected for %.',\r\n            NEW.name;\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n    -- NO DUPLICATE SUBJECTS\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n    IF v_distinct_count <> cardinality(NEW.stream) THEN\r\n        RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n            'Duplicate subjects are not allowed for %.',\r\n            NEW.name;\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n    -- CLASS LIMITS\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n    IF v_class_level IN (9, 10) THEN\r\n\r\n        v_max_subjects := 5;\r\n\r\n        v_has_comp :=\r\n            'Comp' = ANY(NEW.stream);\r\n\r\n        v_has_bio :=\r\n            'Bio' = ANY(NEW.stream);\r\n\r\n\r\n        -- SSC still treats Computer / Biology as alternatives.\r\n        IF v_has_comp AND v_has_bio THEN\r\n            RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n                'Classes 9/10 cannot have both Computer and Biology.';\r\n        END IF;\r\n\r\n    ELSE\r\n\r\n        -- HSSC is intentionally flexible.\r\n        -- Any combination of allowed subjects is permitted,\r\n        -- but maximum 4 subjects.\r\n        v_max_subjects := 4;\r\n\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    IF cardinality(NEW.stream) > v_max_subjects THEN\r\n        RAISE EXCEPTION\r\n            'Class % students can have maximum % subjects.',\r\n            v_class_level,\r\n            v_max_subjects;\r\n    END IF;\r\n\r\n\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n    -- NORMALIZE ARRAY ORDER\r\n    --\r\n    -- Deterministic ordering helps Flutter, reports and audits.\r\n    -- --------------------------------------------------------\r\n\r\n    SELECT array_agg(\r\n        u.subject_code\r\n        ORDER BY\r\n            CASE u.subject_code\r\n                WHEN 'Phy'  THEN 1\r\n                WHEN 'Chem' THEN 2\r\n                WHEN 'Math' THEN 3\r\n                WHEN 'Eng'  THEN 4\r\n                WHEN 'Comp' THEN 5\r\n                WHEN 'Bio'  THEN 6\r\n                ELSE 99\r\n            END\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    INTO NEW.stream\r\n\r\n    FROM unnest(NEW.stream)\r\n        AS u(subject_code);\r\n\r\n\r\n    RETURN NEW;\r\n\r\nEND;\r\n$function$\n"
